cyb-a12-sicher.note: Also “sure”: Ich bin sicher — I'm sure.

cyb-a12-unsicher.example: The Wi-Fi in the café is not secure.

cyb-a12-anmelden.example: I sign in with my password.

cyb-a12-abmelden.tr: to sign out, to log out
cyb-a12-abmelden.example: Always sign out at the end!

cyb-a12-wlan.example: The Wi-Fi in the hotel is free.

cyb-a12-virus.note: For computers usually “der Virus”; in biology more often “das Virus”.

cyb-a12-02-oeffentlich.note: Also “public” as in public transport: öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

cyb-a12-02-teilen.example: I share the video with my class.

cyb-a12-02-sichtbar.note: sichtbar für + Akk: visible to someone.
cyb-a12-02-sichtbar.example: My profile is only visible to friends.

cyb-a12-02-einstellung.example: Open the settings in the app!

cyb-a12-02-fremde.note: Declined like an adjective: der Fremde, ein Fremder; for a woman — die Fremde.
cyb-a12-02-fremde.example: A stranger writes me a message.

cyb-a12-02-annehmen.note: Separable prefix: ich nehme die Anfrage an.
cyb-a12-02-annehmen.example: I'm happy to accept the request.

cyb-a12-02-ablehnen.note: Separable prefix: sie lehnt die Anfrage ab.

cyb-a12-02-kommentar.example: Under the photo there is a mean comment.

cyb-a12-02-peinlich.note: Das ist mir peinlich — I'm embarrassed.
cyb-a12-02-peinlich.example: The photo from the party is embarrassing.

cyb-a12-03-e-mail.note: Short: die Mail. In Austria you also hear das E-Mail.
cyb-a12-03-e-mail.example: Today I get a strange email.

cyb-a12-03-anklicken.note: Separable prefix; + Akk: den Link anklicken = auf den Link klicken.
cyb-a12-03-anklicken.example: I don't click on the link.

cyb-a12-03-echt.note: Colloquially also “really”: echt gut — really good.

cyb-a12-03-dringend.example: The bank writes: This is urgent!

cyb-a12-03-gewinn.example: The email promises a big prize.

cyb-a12-03-fehler.example: The text has a lot of mistakes.

cyb-a12-03-webseite.example: The website looks like my bank.

cyb-a12-03-gutschein.example: A voucher for fifty euros? That's strange!

cyb-a12-03-trick.example: That's an old trick of scammers.

cyb-a12-04-handy.note: A pseudo-anglicism: English speakers don't say “handy” for a phone.
cyb-a12-04-handy.example: My phone is on the table.

cyb-a12-04-sperren.note: + Akk: das Handy sperren. Also ein Konto sperren — to block an account.

cyb-a12-04-entsperren.note: The prefix ent- is inseparable and means “remove, undo”.
cyb-a12-04-entsperren.example: She unlocks the phone with her finger.

cyb-a12-04-pin.note: People say die PIN or der PIN-Code.

cyb-a12-04-sperrbildschirm.example: On the lock screen I see the time.

cyb-a12-04-muster.example: A simple pattern is not secure.

cyb-a12-04-verlieren.example: I lost my phone on the bus.

cyb-a12-04-fundbuero.example: Maybe your phone is at the lost and found.

cyb-a12-04-eingeben.note: Separable prefix: ich gebe die PIN ein.
cyb-a12-04-eingeben.example: Don't enter your PIN in front of others!

cyb-a12-04-leihen.note: jemandem (Dat) etwas (Akk) leihen. sich etwas leihen — to borrow something.
cyb-a12-04-leihen.example: Can you lend me your phone for a moment?

cyb-a12-04-neugierig.note: neugierig auf + Akk: curious about something.
cyb-a12-04-neugierig.example: My little brother is very curious.

cyb-a12-04-daumen.example: I unlock the phone with my thumb.

cyb-a12-05-update.note: Pronounced as in English. Synonym: die Aktualisierung.
cyb-a12-05-update.example: There is an update for my phone.

cyb-a12-05-installieren.note: Verbs in -ieren form the Perfekt without ge-: hat installiert.
cyb-a12-05-installieren.example: I'll install the update this evening.

cyb-a12-05-automatisch.note: As an adverb without an ending: Das geht automatisch.

cyb-a12-05-neu-starten.note: Written as two words, neu goes to the end: Ich starte den Computer neu.

cyb-a12-05-herunterladen.note: Separable prefix: Ich lade … herunter. Colloquially: downloaden.

cyb-a12-05-aktuell.example: The app is up to date again now.

cyb-a12-05-speicher.example: There isn't enough free storage for the update.

cyb-a12-05-neustart.example: After the update the phone needs a restart.

cyb-a12-05-dauern.note: Das dauert lange — that takes a long time.
cyb-a12-05-dauern.example: The update is taking a very long time.

cyb-a12-05-warten.note: warten auf + Akk: to wait for something / someone.
cyb-a12-05-warten.example: I'm waiting for the new update.

cyb-a12-05-laptop.note: Also das Laptop; synonym: das Notebook.
cyb-a12-05-laptop.example: My laptop is already very old.

cyb-a12-05-fertig.collocation: to be done, to be ready

cyb-a12-05-akku.note: Der Akku ist leer — the battery is flat.

cyb-a12-05-betriebssystem.note: Betrieb (operation) + s + System. For example: Windows, Android.
cyb-a12-05-betriebssystem.example: The operating system needs an update.

cyb-a12-05-wichtig.example: Updates are very important for security.

cyb-a12-06-unterwegs.tr: on the way, on the go, out and about
cyb-a12-06-unterwegs.note: unterwegs sein — to be on the road.
cyb-a12-06-unterwegs.example: On the way I read my messages.

cyb-a12-06-netz.note: im Netz — online; kein Netz haben — to have no signal.
cyb-a12-06-netz.example: On the train I have no signal.

cyb-a12-06-verbinden.note: sich verbinden mit + Dat: to connect to something. The prefix ver- is inseparable.
cyb-a12-06-verbinden.example: My phone connects to the Wi-Fi.

cyb-a12-06-hotspot.example: There is a free hotspot at the station.

cyb-a12-06-kostenlos.example: The Wi-Fi on the train is free.

cyb-a12-06-bahnhof.example: I'm waiting for the train at the station.

cyb-a12-06-zug.example: The train to Graz is full.

cyb-a12-06-empfang.note: No plural in this sense (die Empfänge means “receptions, parties”).
cyb-a12-06-empfang.example: In the tunnel I have no reception.

cyb-a12-06-bluetooth.note: Usually without an article: Bluetooth ist an / aus.

cyb-a12-06-einschalten.tr: to switch on, to turn on
cyb-a12-06-einschalten.note: Separable prefix: Ich schalte … ein. Colloquially: anmachen.
cyb-a12-06-einschalten.example: I only turn on Bluetooth at home.

cyb-a12-06-ausschalten.tr: to switch off, to turn off
cyb-a12-06-ausschalten.note: Separable prefix: Ich schalte … aus. Colloquially: ausmachen.
cyb-a12-06-ausschalten.example: On the train Sara turns off Bluetooth.

cyb-a12-07-adresse.example: Don't write your address on the internet!

cyb-a12-07-telefonnummer.example: Don't give your phone number to everyone!

cyb-a12-07-geburtstag.note: die Geburt (birth) + s + der Tag. Ich habe heute Geburtstag — it's my birthday today.

cyb-a12-07-foto.example: In the photo you can see my house.

cyb-a12-07-vorname.note: der Vorname — first name, der Nachname — surname.

cyb-a12-07-wohnen.note: wohnen in + Dat: Ich wohne in Wien. (leben — to live in general.)
cyb-a12-07-wohnen.example: Paula lives with her family in Vienna.

cyb-a12-07-ausfuellen.tr: to fill in, to fill out (a form)
cyb-a12-07-ausfuellen.note: Separable prefix: Ich fülle das Formular aus.
cyb-a12-07-ausfuellen.example: I fill in the form online.

cyb-a12-07-daten.note: In the sense of “data” — plural only.

cyb-a12-07-verraten.tr: to reveal, to give away (a secret)

cyb-a12-07-verraten.example: He doesn't give away his address.

cyb-a12-07-unbekannt.example: An unknown person is writing to me.

cyb-a12-07-gewinnspiel.note: der Gewinn (prize) + das Spiel. Often a trap to collect data.
cyb-a12-07-gewinnspiel.example: In this prize draw you can win a phone.

cyb-a12-07-ausweis.note: der Personalausweis — ID card, der Schülerausweis — student ID.
cyb-a12-07-ausweis.example: Don't take a photo of your ID!

cyb-a12-07-strasse.note: In an address: street + house number, for example Hauptstraße.
cyb-a12-07-strasse.example: Which street do you live on?

cyb-a12-08-online-shop.collocation: to buy in an online shop
cyb-a12-08-online-shop.example: I buy my shoes in an online shop.

cyb-a12-08-bestellen.note: etwas (Akk) bestellen; bei + Dat: bei einem Shop bestellen.
cyb-a12-08-bestellen.example: I order a book on the internet.

cyb-a12-08-warenkorb.example: The jacket is already in the cart.

cyb-a12-08-bezahlen.note: etwas (Akk) bezahlen; mit + Dat: mit der Karte bezahlen.

cyb-a12-08-kreditkarte.example: My mother has a credit card.

cyb-a12-09-problem.example: I have a problem with my account.

cyb-a12-09-erzaehlen.note: jemandem (Dat) etwas (Akk) erzählen; erzählen von + Dat.
cyb-a12-09-erzaehlen.example: Tell your parents about the problem!

cyb-a12-09-angst.note: Angst haben vor + Dat — to be afraid of something.

cyb-a12-09-mobbing.example: Bullying in the class chat is not okay.

cyb-a12-09-screenshot.example: Take a screenshot of the message!

cyb-a12-09-beleidigen.example: A boy insults her in the chat.

cyb-a12-09-polizei.example: We go to the police together.

cyb-a12-09-anzeige.note: Also “advert”. Anzeige erstatten — to report to the police.
cyb-a12-09-anzeige.example: Dad files a report with the police.

cyb-a12-10-vorsichtig.note: vorsichtig sein mit + Dat — to be careful with something.

cyb-a12-10-aufpassen.tr: to pay attention; to look after
cyb-a12-10-aufpassen.note: aufpassen auf + Akk; separable prefix: Pass … auf!

cyb-a12-10-kontrollieren.example: I check the address in the browser.

cyb-a12-10-nachdenken.tr: to think (about), to think it over
cyb-a12-10-nachdenken.note: nachdenken über + Akk; separable prefix: Denk … nach!

cyb-a12-10-pause.example: After an hour I take a break.

cyb-a12-10-bildschirmzeit.example: My screen time is too long.

cyb-a12-10-webcam.example: The webcam is at the top of the laptop.

cyb-a12-10-routine.example: Updates are a routine for me.

cyb-a12-10-achten.example: Pay attention to the padlock in the browser!

inf-a12-ordner.example: The file is in the folder.

inf-a12-internet.example: I'm looking for it on the internet.

inf-a12-email.note: In Austria and Switzerland often “das E-Mail”.

inf-a12-02-browser.example: I open the browser on the laptop.

inf-a12-02-suchen.note: suchen + Akk: ein Rezept suchen; nach + Dat: nach Informationen suchen.

inf-a12-02-information.note: Often plural: viele Informationen — a lot of information.
inf-a12-02-information.example: I find a lot of information online.

inf-a12-02-lesezeichen.example: I make a bookmark for the website.

inf-a12-02-tab.note: Also das Tab; officially: die Registerkarte.

inf-a12-02-nachricht.example: I have a message from Mia.

inf-a12-02-senden.note: senden + Akk + Dat: Ich sende dir den Link. Synonym: schicken.

inf-a12-03-smartphone.note: In conversation more often: das Handy.

inf-a12-03-laden.note: Strong verb: du lädst, er lädt. Synonym: aufladen.

inf-a12-03-voll.example: Now the battery is full again.

inf-a12-03-display.note: For a computer people usually say der Bildschirm.

inf-a12-03-kamera.example: The camera on my phone is very good.

inf-a12-03-foto.example: I'm taking a photo of you.

inf-a12-03-fotografieren.note: Perfekt without ge-: hat fotografiert. fotografieren + Akk.

inf-a12-03-anruf.example: I have a call from Dad.

inf-a12-03-kontakt.example: I save the contact in my phone.

inf-a12-03-tippen.note: auf + Akk: auf das Symbol tippen.

inf-a12-04-platz.note: Platz nehmen — to take a seat (polite).

inf-a12-04-stecker.example: The plug isn't in the socket.

inf-a12-04-ausschalten.tr: to switch off, to turn off
inf-a12-04-ausschalten.note: Separable prefix: Wir schalten die Computer aus. In speech also: ausmachen.

inf-a12-04-regel.example: There are rules in the computer room.

inf-a12-04-sich-abmelden.note: Reflexive, separable prefix: ich melde mich ab.

inf-a12-04-usb-stick.example: The file is on my USB stick.

inf-a12-04-vergessen.note: Strong verb: du vergisst, er vergisst. vergessen + Akk.

inf-a12-04-aufraeumen.note: Separable prefix: Wir räumen den Platz auf.
inf-a12-04-aufraeumen.example: After the lesson we tidy up.

inf-a12-05-buchstabe.note: Special declension: den / dem / des Buchstaben.

inf-a12-05-wort.note: Plural Wörter — separate words; Worte — “words, a statement”.
inf-a12-05-wort.example: How do you spell this word?

inf-a12-05-satz.example: The first sentence is very long.

inf-a12-05-seite.example: The document has only one page.

inf-a12-05-absatz.example: The second paragraph is very short.

inf-a12-05-kopieren.note: kopieren + Akk; on the keyboard Ctrl + C (German: Strg + C).

inf-a12-05-einfuegen.note: Separable prefix: ich füge den Text ein. On the keyboard Ctrl + V.
inf-a12-05-einfuegen.example: Now I paste the text at the bottom.

inf-a12-05-ausschneiden.note: Separable prefix: ich schneide das Wort aus. On the keyboard Ctrl + X.

inf-a12-05-fett.note: For fonts: fett — bold, kursiv — italic.

inf-a12-05-rueckgaengig-machen.note: etwas rückgängig machen; on the keyboard Ctrl + Z.

inf-a12-06-kalender.example: The appointment is in the calendar.

inf-a12-06-termin.note: Not “term”! A term (word) in German is der Fachbegriff.

inf-a12-06-datum.note: Plural Daten is the same as the word for “data”.

inf-a12-06-uhrzeit.example: The time is shown at the top right.

inf-a12-06-eintragen.tr: to enter, to put down (in a calendar, list)
inf-a12-06-eintragen.note: Separable prefix: ich trage den Termin ein. eintragen in + Akk.
inf-a12-06-eintragen.example: I put the appointment in the calendar.

inf-a12-06-wochentag.example: What day of the week is it today?

inf-a12-06-verschieben.tr: to postpone, to move (to another time)
inf-a12-06-verschieben.note: Inseparable prefix ver-; verschieben auf + Akk — to move to …
inf-a12-06-verschieben.example: We're moving the meeting to Friday.

inf-a12-06-absagen.note: Separable prefix: ich sage den Termin ab.
inf-a12-06-absagen.example: Unfortunately I have to cancel the appointment.

inf-a12-06-puenktlich.example: The bus is on time today.

inf-a12-06-wecker.example: My alarm goes off at seven.

inf-a12-06-stundenplan.example: My timetable is very full on Monday.

inf-a12-06-frei.note: Ich habe frei — I have the day off.
inf-a12-06-frei.example: On Friday I have the day off.

inf-a12-06-ferien.example: In the holidays we're going to Graz.

inf-a12-07-problem.example: I have a problem with the printer.

inf-a12-07-neu-starten.note: Written as two words; neu goes to the end: Ich starte den Computer neu.

inf-a12-07-haengen.tr: to freeze, to hang (of a computer); to hang
inf-a12-07-haengen.note: Der Computer hängt — the computer has frozen. Perfekt: hat gehangen (in Austria and southern Germany: ist gehangen).

inf-a12-07-techniker.example: The technician is coming in the afternoon.

inf-a12-07-anrufen.note: Separable prefix; + Akk: ich rufe dich an.

inf-a12-07-warten.note: warten auf + Akk: Ich warte auf den Techniker.
inf-a12-07-warten.example: I've been waiting for ten minutes.

inf-a12-07-garantie.example: The phone still has two years of warranty.

inf-a12-07-tipp.example: Do you have a tip for me?

inf-a12-07-ausprobieren.note: Separable prefix: ich probiere es aus.
inf-a12-07-ausprobieren.example: I'm trying out the new app.

inf-a12-07-schwarz.note: Der Bildschirm bleibt schwarz — the screen stays black (shows nothing).

inf-a12-08-lektion.note: Lektion is part of a course or textbook; a school lesson is die Stunde.
inf-a12-08-lektion.example: Today I'm doing the third lesson.

inf-a12-08-anschauen.note: Separable prefix: ich schaue … an. The everyday word in Austria and the south; synonym ansehen.

inf-a12-08-webcam.example: The webcam is at the top of the screen.

inf-a12-08-kopfhoerer.note: der Kopfhörer — a pair of headphones; plural also Kopfhörer.
inf-a12-08-kopfhoerer.example: Without headphones I can't hear anything.

inf-a12-08-lernplattform.example: The school's learning platform is called Moodle.

inf-a12-08-chat.example: I write my question in the chat.

inf-a12-08-ton.example: I can see you, but the sound is bad.

inf-a12-08-stummschalten.note: Separable part: ich schalte das Mikrofon stumm.

inf-a12-08-pause.example: After the lesson we take a break.

inf-a12-08-wiederholen.note: Inseparable prefix: ich wiederhole, participle without ge-.
inf-a12-08-wiederholen.example: Can you repeat the question, please?

inf-a12-08-test.example: On Friday we're taking a test.

inf-a12-08-zertifikat.example: After the course I'll get a certificate.

inf-a12-09-spiel.example: The game is new and free.

inf-a12-09-spielen.note: No preposition: ein Spiel spielen, Gitarre spielen.
inf-a12-09-spielen.example: At the weekend I play with friends.

inf-a12-09-spieler.example: The player starts in the first level.

inf-a12-09-level.example: The last level is very hard.

inf-a12-09-punkt.example: For every star you get a point.

inf-a12-09-verlieren.note: Also “to lose” an object: das Handy verlieren.

inf-a12-09-spielkonsole.example: My friend has a new games console.

inf-a12-09-controller.example: The controller has a lot of buttons.

inf-a12-09-runde.example: Come on, let's play one more round!

inf-a12-09-leben.example: I only have one life left.

inf-a12-09-gegner.example: The opponent is strong and fast.

inf-a12-09-springen.note: Perfekt with sein: ich bin gesprungen.
inf-a12-09-springen.example: The character jumps over the river.

inf-a12-09-schaffen.tr: to manage (to do), to make it
inf-a12-09-schaffen.note: Colloquial: Ich habe es geschafft! — I did it!

inf-a12-09-rekord.example: My brother has a new record.

inf-a12-10-knipsen.note: Colloquial; neutral — fotografieren. No preposition: den Hund knipsen.
inf-a12-10-knipsen.example: I like taking pictures of animals at the zoo.

inf-a12-10-selfie.example: We take a selfie in front of the school.

inf-a12-10-galerie.note: On a phone — the place where all your photos are.
inf-a12-10-galerie.example: The photo is in the gallery.

inf-a12-10-album.example: I'm making an album for the holiday.

inf-a12-10-teilen.note: etwas mit + Dat teilen: das Foto mit Freunden teilen.
inf-a12-10-teilen.example: I share the video with my class.

inf-a12-10-filter.example: With this filter the picture is black and white.

inf-a12-10-dunkel.note: With an ending the e drops out: ein dunkles Bild.
inf-a12-10-dunkel.example: Unfortunately the photo is too dark.

inf-a12-10-musik.example: I like listening to music while I study.

inf-a12-10-lied.example: This song is very well known.

inf-a12-10-hoeren.note: No preposition: Musik hören, das Radio hören.
inf-a12-10-hoeren.example: Can you hear the new song?

inf-a12-10-lautsprecher.example: The speaker is small but loud.

inf-a12-10-leise.example: Please speak quietly, the baby is sleeping.

inf-a12-10-playlist.example: My playlist has a lot of songs.

inf-a12-10-streamen.note: From English, conjugated like a regular verb: ich streame.
inf-a12-10-streamen.example: I stream music on my phone.

mat-a12-rechnen.example: I like doing sums in my head.

mat-a12-geteilt.example: Twelve divided by four is three.

mat-a12-loesen.example: I solve the problem on my own.

mat-a12-summe.example: The sum of two and three is five.

mat-a12-02-ziffer.note: Ziffer — a sign (0–9), Zahl — a number. The number 25 has two digits.

mat-a12-02-stelle.note: an der ersten Stelle — in first place; eine vierstellige Zahl — a four-digit number.
mat-a12-02-stelle.example: In the first place there is a five.

mat-a12-02-einer.note: Place values: Einer, Zehner, Hunderter, Tausender.
mat-a12-02-einer.example: In the number 34 the four is the ones.

mat-a12-02-million.example: Vienna has almost two million inhabitants.

mat-a12-02-milliarde.note: Trap: English billion = German Milliarde; German Billion is a trillion.
mat-a12-02-milliarde.example: Eight billion people live on Earth.

mat-a12-02-einwohner.note: Feminine: die Einwohnerin. Wie viele Einwohner hat …? — How many inhabitants does … have?

mat-a12-02-zaehlen.note: zählen — to count things (1, 2, 3 …), rechnen — to calculate.
mat-a12-02-zaehlen.example: My little brother can count to a hundred.

mat-a12-02-komma.note: German uses a comma for decimals: 1,5 — eins Komma fünf (1.5).
mat-a12-02-komma.example: After the comma come the cents.

mat-a12-02-runden.note: auf + Akk runden: auf zwei Stellen runden — to round to two places.
mat-a12-02-runden.example: We round the result to two places.

mat-a12-02-aufrunden.note: Separable prefix auf-: Ich runde auf.

mat-a12-02-genau.example: The bread costs exactly two euros.

mat-a12-02-zahlenstrahl.example: On the number line the three is to the left of the four.

mat-a12-03-uhr.note: Um drei Uhr — at three o'clock. Wie viel Uhr ist es? — What time is it?
mat-a12-03-uhr.example: The clock on the wall is slow.

mat-a12-03-zeiger.note: der große Zeiger — minute hand, der kleine Zeiger — hour hand.
mat-a12-03-zeiger.example: The small hand is on the three.

mat-a12-03-viertel.note: Viertel nach acht — 8:15, Viertel vor neun — 8:45.
mat-a12-03-viertel.example: The lesson starts at a quarter past eight.

mat-a12-03-halb.tr: half; (in times) half to the next hour
mat-a12-03-halb.note: Trap: halb neun = 8:30, i.e. half past eight, not 9:30.

mat-a12-03-sekunde.example: Sara runs a hundred metres in fourteen seconds.

mat-a12-03-stoppuhr.example: The teacher has a stopwatch in his hand.

mat-a12-03-dauern.note: Wie lange dauert …? — How long does … take?

mat-a12-03-fahrplan.note: laut Fahrplan — according to the timetable.
mat-a12-03-fahrplan.example: According to the timetable the bus comes at ten.

mat-a12-03-ankunft.example: The arrival in Salzburg is at one.

mat-a12-03-verspaetung.note: Der Zug hat Verspätung — the train is late.
mat-a12-03-verspaetung.collocation: to be late, to be delayed
mat-a12-03-verspaetung.example: The train is twenty minutes late.

mat-a12-03-puenktlich.example: The train is on time today.

mat-a12-03-umsteigen.example: We have to change in Linz.

mat-a12-03-zeitunterschied.example: The time difference to New York is six hours.

mat-a12-03-mitternacht.example: At midnight it's zero hundred hours.

mat-a12-04-taschengeld.example: I get ten euros pocket money a week.

mat-a12-04-sparschwein.example: The piggy bank is almost full.

mat-a12-04-sparen.note: für + Akk sparen — to save for something.
mat-a12-04-sparen.example: Paul is saving for a bike.

mat-a12-04-ausgeben.note: Geld für + Akk ausgeben — to spend money on something.
mat-a12-04-ausgeben.example: He spends too much money on sweets.

mat-a12-04-muenze.example: I only have coins in my pocket.

mat-a12-04-geldschein.note: Short: der Schein. ein Zehn-Euro-Schein — a ten-euro note.
mat-a12-04-geldschein.example: Paul puts a banknote in the piggy bank.

mat-a12-04-teuer.note: Before a noun the -e- drops: ein teures Fahrrad.

mat-a12-04-betrag.note: Summe — result of adding in maths, Betrag — amount of money (and absolute value).
mat-a12-04-betrag.example: The amount is two hundred euros.

mat-a12-04-kosten.note: Was kostet das? / Wie viel kostet das? — How much is it?
mat-a12-04-kosten.example: How much is the ice cream?

mat-a12-04-bezahlen.note: No ge- in the Perfekt: hat bezahlt. bar bezahlen — to pay cash.

mat-a12-04-wechselgeld.example: The shop assistant gives me my change.

mat-a12-04-rabatt.note: zehn Prozent Rabatt — ten per cent off.

mat-a12-04-kassenbon.note: In Austria people also say die Rechnung and der Kassenzettel.

mat-a12-04-billig.note: More neutral: günstig — good value, inexpensive.

mat-a12-04-zurueckgeben.example: The shop assistant gives him 25 euros back.

mat-a12-05-meter.note: Plural = singular: zwei Meter. Abbreviation: m.
mat-a12-05-meter.example: The wall is three metres long.

mat-a12-05-zentimeter.note: Ein Meter hat hundert Zentimeter. Abbreviation: cm.

mat-a12-05-kilometer.note: Abbreviation: km. Read in full: zwei Kilometer.
mat-a12-05-kilometer.example: The school is two kilometres away.

mat-a12-05-lineal.note: Stress on the last syllable: Line-ÁL.
mat-a12-05-lineal.example: I draw a straight line with the ruler.

mat-a12-05-massband.note: das Maß — measure, das Band — tape.
mat-a12-05-massband.example: Dad gets the tape measure out of the box.

mat-a12-05-messen.note: Strong verb: ich messe, du misst, er misst.

mat-a12-05-breit.note: die Breite — width. Wie breit ist …? — How wide is …?

mat-a12-05-hoch.note: Before a noun: ein hoher Turm (the c drops). die Höhe — height.
mat-a12-05-hoch.example: The shelf is two metres high.

mat-a12-05-kilogramm.note: Neuter! In speech: das Kilo. Abbreviation: kg.

mat-a12-05-liter.note: ein halber Liter — half a litre. Abbreviation: l.
mat-a12-05-liter.example: I'm buying a litre of milk.

mat-a12-05-waage.note: In German it's singular: die Waage (one set of scales).

mat-a12-05-schwer.note: Two meanings: Die Kiste ist schwer (heavy), Die Aufgabe ist schwer (difficult).
mat-a12-05-schwer.example: The bag with the books is heavy.

mat-a12-05-leicht.note: Also two meanings: light in weight and easy.

mat-a12-05-einheit.note: Meter, Gramm und Liter sind Einheiten.
mat-a12-05-einheit.example: A pound is an old unit.

mat-a12-06-form.note: Welche Form hat …? — What shape is …?

mat-a12-06-quadrat.note: Neuter: das Quadrat. All four sides are equal.
mat-a12-06-quadrat.example: A square has four equal sides.

mat-a12-06-ecke.note: Ecke — a corner/vertex; Winkel — an angle measured in degrees.

mat-a12-06-linie.example: Draw a line from A to B.

mat-a12-06-punkt.note: Two meanings: a point in geometry and a point on a test.
mat-a12-06-punkt.example: Point A lies on the line.

mat-a12-06-rund.example: The table in the kitchen is round.

mat-a12-06-eckig.example: The picture has corners, the mirror is round.

mat-a12-06-zeichnen.note: zeichnen — with a pencil, lines; malen — with paint.
mat-a12-06-zeichnen.example: We draw a house out of shapes.

mat-a12-06-wuerfel.note: In a game: würfeln — to roll the dice.

mat-a12-06-kugel.note: eine Kugel Eis — a scoop of ice cream.
mat-a12-06-kugel.example: A ball has the shape of a sphere.

mat-a12-06-kante.note: A cube has 12 Kanten (edges) and 8 Ecken (vertices).

mat-a12-06-flach.example: A sheet of paper is flat.

mat-a12-06-spitze.example: The pyramid has a point at the top.

mat-a12-06-mitte.note: in der Mitte — in the middle.
mat-a12-06-mitte.example: In the centre of the circle there is a point.

mat-a12-06-schachtel.example: The box has the shape of a cube.

mat-a12-06-stern.example: On the paper there is a golden star.

mat-a12-07-tafel.note: an die Tafel schreiben — to write on the board; an der Tafel stehen — to stand at the board.
mat-a12-07-tafel.example: The teacher writes the problem on the board.

mat-a12-07-taschenrechner.example: The calculator is allowed in the test.

mat-a12-07-kopfrechnen.note: der Kopf (head) + rechnen. Verb: im Kopf rechnen.
mat-a12-07-kopfrechnen.example: Sara is very fast at mental arithmetic.

mat-a12-07-rechenweg.tr: working, how you got the answer
mat-a12-07-rechenweg.note: Teachers say: Schreib den Rechenweg auf! — Show your working!
mat-a12-07-rechenweg.example: Please explain your working to us.

mat-a12-07-erklaeren.note: jemandem etwas erklären — to explain something to someone. No ge- in the Perfekt.
mat-a12-07-erklaeren.example: The teacher explains the problem again.

mat-a12-07-sich-melden.tr: to put your hand up (in class)
mat-a12-07-sich-melden.note: At school sich melden = to raise your hand to answer.
mat-a12-07-sich-melden.example: Sara puts her hand up right away.

mat-a12-07-hausuebung.note: In Austria — die Hausübung, in Germany — die Hausaufgabe.
mat-a12-07-hausuebung.example: For homework we're doing ten problems.

mat-a12-07-schularbeit.note: Austrian word for a big written test in class. In Germany: die Klassenarbeit.
mat-a12-07-schularbeit.example: Next week we have a test.

mat-a12-07-fehler.note: einen Fehler machen — to make a mistake.

mat-a12-07-korrigieren.note: The teacher korrigiert die Schularbeit — marks the test.
mat-a12-07-korrigieren.example: The teacher marks the exercise books at the weekend.

mat-a12-07-abschreiben.tr: to copy, to cheat; to copy out
mat-a12-07-abschreiben.note: von jemandem abschreiben — to copy from someone.

mat-a12-07-note.note: In Austria 1 (Sehr gut) is the best, 5 (Nicht genügend) the worst.
mat-a12-07-note.example: For the test Max gets a 2 (“good”).

mat-a12-07-ueben.example: I practise for twenty minutes every day.

mat-a12-07-nervoes.example: Max is nervous before the test.

mat-a12-07-zeugnis.note: Plural with double s: die Zeugnisse.
mat-a12-07-zeugnis.example: In her report Sara has a 1 (the top grade) in maths.

mat-a12-08-teilen.note: In maths: 12 geteilt durch 3. In life: etwas mit jemandem teilen — to share.
mat-a12-08-teilen.example: We divide the pizza into eight pieces.

mat-a12-08-stueck.note: ein Stück Pizza — a piece of pizza. 2 Euro pro Stück — 2 euros each.

mat-a12-08-achtel.note: Fractions in -tel: Drittel, Viertel, Fünftel, Achtel. All neuter.
mat-a12-08-achtel.example: One piece is an eighth of the pizza.

mat-a12-08-drittel.example: A third of the chocolate is for Tom.

mat-a12-08-verteilen.note: etwas an + Akk verteilen — to hand something out to someone.
mat-a12-08-verteilen.example: Mum hands out the pieces to the children.

mat-a12-08-gleichmaessig.example: We share out the pieces equally.

mat-a12-08-rest.note: In division: 7 geteilt durch 2 ist 3, Rest 1.

mat-a12-08-uebrig.note: Usually in übrig sein / übrig bleiben — to be left over.
mat-a12-08-uebrig.example: At the end one piece is left over.

mat-a12-08-prozent.note: After a number no ending: 50 Prozent. Sign: %.

mat-a12-08-anteil.example: The proportion of girls in the class is large.

mat-a12-08-abstimmen.note: über + Akk abstimmen — to vote on something. Noun: die Abstimmung.
mat-a12-08-abstimmen.example: The class votes on the trip.

mat-a12-08-mehrheit.example: The majority wants to go to the zoo.

mat-a12-08-doppelt.note: doppelt so viele wie — twice as many as.
mat-a12-08-doppelt.example: The zoo has more than twice as many votes.

mat-a12-08-ganz.note: die ganze Klasse — the whole class; ganz gut — quite good.

mat-a12-09-strichliste.note: der Strich — stroke, line. Every fifth stroke crosses out four.
mat-a12-09-strichliste.example: Lea makes a tally on the board.

mat-a12-09-tabelle.example: We write the numbers in a table.

mat-a12-09-eintragen.tr: to enter, to fill in (in a table, list)
mat-a12-09-eintragen.note: etwas in + Akk eintragen. Strong verb: tragen – trug – getragen.
mat-a12-09-eintragen.example: We enter the numbers in the table.

mat-a12-09-diagramm.note: das Balkendiagramm — bar chart, das Kreisdiagramm — pie chart.
mat-a12-09-diagramm.example: At the end we draw a chart.

mat-a12-09-ablesen.tr: to read off (a value from a chart or device)
mat-a12-09-ablesen.note: Strong verb: du liest ab, er liest ab.
mat-a12-09-ablesen.example: You can easily read that off the chart.

mat-a12-09-temperatur.example: On Monday the temperature is twelve degrees.

mat-a12-09-grad.note: After a number no ending: zwanzig Grad. Below zero: minus fünf Grad.

mat-a12-09-sinken.example: At the weekend the temperature falls.

mat-a12-09-durchschnitt.note: im Durchschnitt — on average. The sum divided by the count.
mat-a12-09-durchschnitt.example: On average it was fifteen degrees.

mat-a12-09-wert.note: der höchste Wert — the highest value.
mat-a12-09-wert.example: The highest value is twenty degrees.

mat-a12-09-kurve.example: The curve goes up at first.

mat-a12-09-vergleichen.note: etwas mit + Dat vergleichen. Strong verb: verglich – verglichen.
mat-a12-09-vergleichen.example: We compare this week with last week.

mat-a12-10-raetsel.note: ein Rätsel lösen — to solve a puzzle.
mat-a12-10-raetsel.example: Grandpa has a new puzzle for Lena.

mat-a12-10-raten.note: Strong verb: du rätst, er rät. Rate mal! — Have a guess!

mat-a12-10-reihe.note: Du bist an der Reihe! — It's your turn!

mat-a12-10-regel.example: The rule is: always times two.

mat-a12-10-hinweis.note: einen Hinweis geben — to give a hint.

mat-a12-10-fortsetzen.note: Separable prefix fort- (onward). Setz die Reihe fort! — Continue the sequence!

mat-a12-10-knobeln.tr: to puzzle over, to rack your brains
mat-a12-10-knobeln.note: Colloquial. die Knobelaufgabe — a brain teaser.

mat-a12-10-schach.note: Singular in German: Schach spielen. Schachmatt! — Checkmate!
mat-a12-10-schach.example: In the evening Lena plays chess with Grandpa.

mat-a12-10-zug.note: Another meaning: train. Du bist am Zug — it's your move.

mat-a12-10-strategie.note: Stress on the last syllable: Strate-GIE.
mat-a12-10-strategie.example: Grandpa always has a good strategy.

mat-a12-10-unentschieden.note: Das Spiel endet unentschieden — the game ends in a draw.
mat-a12-10-unentschieden.example: Today the game ends in a draw.

mat-a12-10-sudoku.example: There's a sudoku in the newspaper every day.

mat-a12-10-kaestchen.note: Diminutive of der Kasten (box). -chen is always neuter.

cyb-a2-angriff.note: Angriff auf + Akk: an attack on something.
cyb-a2-angriff.example: Yesterday there was an attack on the server.

cyb-a2-angreifer.example: The attacker wants to get at the data.

cyb-a2-sicherheitsluecke.example: The update closes a security hole.

cyb-a2-zugriff.collocation: to have access to the data
cyb-a2-zugriff.example: Only admins have access to the server.

cyb-a2-phishingmail.example: Don't click on the link in the phishing email!

cyb-a2-melden.example: Report suspicious emails to the IT department!

cyb-a21-02-passwortmanager.example: My password manager creates secure passwords.

cyb-a21-02-sonderzeichen.note: Sonder- — special, das Zeichen — character. For example: ! ? # %.
cyb-a21-02-sonderzeichen.example: The password needs at least one special character.

cyb-a21-02-erraten.note: Conjugated like raten: du errätst, er errät. The prefix er- is inseparable.

cyb-a21-02-wiederverwenden.note: Separable prefix wieder-: er verwendet das Passwort wieder.

cyb-a21-02-grossbuchstabe.note: n-declension: den/dem Großbuchstaben. Opposite — der Kleinbuchstabe.
cyb-a21-02-grossbuchstabe.example: A password also needs capital letters.

cyb-a21-02-ziffer.note: Ziffer — a sign (0–9), Zahl — a number.
cyb-a21-02-ziffer.example: Use letters, digits and special characters!

cyb-a21-02-laenge.example: The length of the password is very important.

cyb-a21-02-merken.note: sich (Dat) etwas merken: ich merke mir das Passwort.

cyb-a21-02-passphrase.note: A password made of several words.
cyb-a21-02-passphrase.example: A passphrase consists of several words.

cyb-a21-02-master-passwort.note: It opens the password manager. Also written as one word: das Masterpasswort.
cyb-a21-02-master-passwort.example: The master password opens the password manager.

cyb-a21-02-speichern.note: speichern in + Dat: im Browser speichern.

cyb-a21-02-knacken.note: Literally “to crack (nuts)”; in IT — to crack a password or cipher.

cyb-a21-02-datenleck.example: After the data breach everyone changes their passwords.

cyb-a21-02-woerterbuchangriff.example: A dictionary attack tries well-known words.

cyb-a21-02-ausprobieren.example: The program tries out lots of passwords.

cyb-a21-02-zufaellig.example: The password manager creates random passwords.

cyb-a21-03-gefaelscht.example: The email has a fake sender.

cyb-a21-03-absenderadresse.example: Always look closely at the sender address!

cyb-a21-03-mauszeiger.example: I move the mouse pointer over the link.

cyb-a21-03-logo.example: The bank's logo looks a bit different.

cyb-a21-03-rechtschreibfehler.note: Die Rechtschreibung — spelling, der Fehler — mistake.
cyb-a21-03-rechtschreibfehler.example: The email has a lot of spelling mistakes.

cyb-a21-03-koeder.note: Phishing comes from fishing: “fishing” for passwords.
cyb-a21-03-koeder.example: A voucher is often just bait.

cyb-a21-03-erkennen.note: Prefix er- is inseparable. erkennen an + Dat — to recognise by something.
cyb-a21-03-erkennen.example: You can often recognise phishing by the language.

cyb-a21-03-spam-ordner.example: The email ended up in the spam folder.

cyb-a21-03-faelschung.example: This website is a good fake.

cyb-a21-03-auffordern.tr: to ask, to demand (that someone does something)
cyb-a21-03-auffordern.note: jemanden zu + Dat auffordern: zur Zahlung auffordern. Separable prefix.
cyb-a21-03-auffordern.example: The email asks me to pay.

cyb-a21-03-zugangsdaten.example: Never pass on your login details by email!

cyb-a21-03-weiterleiten.example: I forward the email to IT.

cyb-a21-03-kennwort.note: Synonym of das Passwort, common in official letters.
cyb-a21-03-kennwort.example: The email asks for my password.

cyb-a21-04-anruf.example: Yesterday there was a strange call supposedly from IT.

cyb-a21-04-vertrauen.note: No plural. Vertrauen zu + Dat / in + Akk.

cyb-a21-04-taeuschen.note: + Akk: jemanden täuschen. sich täuschen — to be mistaken.
cyb-a21-04-taeuschen.example: The caller fooled all of us.

cyb-a21-04-betrueger.note: Feminine: die Betrügerin. Der Betrug — fraud.
cyb-a21-04-betrueger.example: The scammer wanted to get my password.

cyb-a21-04-ausgeben.tr: to pretend to be, to pose as
cyb-a21-04-ausgeben.note: sich als + Nom ausgeben: er gibt sich als Techniker aus. Separable prefix.

cyb-a21-04-druck.note: No plural in this sense. Druck machen — to put pressure on. Also “printing”.
cyb-a21-04-druck.example: The caller puts on a lot of pressure.

cyb-a21-04-mitarbeiter.example: An employee said his password on the phone.

cyb-a21-04-hilfsbereit.example: Scammers take advantage of helpful colleagues.

cyb-a21-04-anrufer.note: anrufen — to call. Feminine: die Anruferin.
cyb-a21-04-anrufer.example: The caller says he's from the bank.

cyb-a21-04-eingang.example: A stranger is waiting at the entrance.

cyb-a21-04-draengen.tr: to rush, to push, to pressure
cyb-a21-04-draengen.note: Pressure and haste are typical social engineering tricks.
cyb-a21-04-draengen.example: The caller pushes me: I should act quickly.

cyb-a21-04-usb-stick.example: There's a USB stick lying in the car park.

cyb-a21-04-hereinfallen.note: hereinfallen auf + Akk; Perfekt with sein. Separable prefix.
cyb-a21-04-hereinfallen.example: Many people fall for this trick.

cyb-a21-05-patch.example: The patch closes the security hole.

cyb-a21-05-veraltet.example: The software on the laptop is outdated.

cyb-a21-05-hersteller.note: From herstellen — to manufacture. Feminine: die Herstellerin.
cyb-a21-05-hersteller.example: The vendor sends updates every month.

cyb-a21-05-sicherheitsupdate.example: An important security update comes out today.

cyb-a21-05-aktualisieren.note: + Akk. Verbs in -ieren form the Perfekt without ge-.
cyb-a21-05-aktualisieren.example: Today we're updating all the laptops.

cyb-a21-05-einspielen.tr: to install, to apply (an update, a patch)
cyb-a21-05-einspielen.note: Separable prefix: er spielt den Patch ein. An admins' word.
cyb-a21-05-einspielen.example: The admin applies the patch in the evening.

cyb-a21-05-treiber.note: Also “drover” (from treiben — to drive). Der Druckertreiber — printer driver.
cyb-a21-05-treiber.example: The printer needs a new driver.

cyb-a21-05-veroeffentlichen.note: Inseparable prefix ver-: Perfekt without ge-.
cyb-a21-05-veroeffentlichen.example: The company is releasing a new version tomorrow.

cyb-a21-05-wartung.example: During maintenance the server is offline.

cyb-a21-05-fehlerbehebung.example: The update contains an important bug fix.
