inf-a21-10-einschreiben.example: Lena is enrolling at the university in the autumn.

inf-a21-10-bestehen.note: + Akk: eine Prüfung bestehen. Don't confuse: bestehen aus + Dat — to consist of.

inf-a21-10-note.note: In Austria: 1 — sehr gut, 2 — gut, 3 — befriedigend, 4 — genügend, 5 — nicht genügend.

inf-a21-10-abgabe.note: From abgeben — to hand in. Die Abgabe ist am Freitag — it's due on Friday.
inf-a21-10-abgabe.example: The deadline for submission is Sunday at midnight.

inf-a21-10-tutorium.note: Usually run by a tutor — an older student.
inf-a21-10-tutorium.example: In the tutorial a student explains the material.

inf-a21-10-lerngruppe.example: Our study group meets every Wednesday.

inf-a21-10-mitschrift.example: Can I copy your notes from yesterday?

inf-a21-10-durchfallen.note: Separable prefix; Perfekt with sein; bei/in + Dat: bei der Prüfung durchfallen.

inf-a21-10-sprechstunde.example: The professor has office hours on Thursday.

inf-a21-10-studium.note: Studium — studying at university; das Studio — studio.
inf-a21-10-studium.example: Studying at TU is hard work.

mat-a2-gleichung.example: We solve an equation with one unknown.

mat-a2-variable.example: In the equation x is a variable.

mat-a2-menge.note: In everyday German: “amount” (eine Menge Arbeit — a lot of work).
mat-a2-menge.example: The set of natural numbers is infinite.

mat-a2-beweis.example: The proof is only half a page long.

mat-a2-beweisen.example: We prove the theorem in the lecture.

mat-a2-satz.example: Pythagoras' theorem is very well known.

mat-a2-vorlesung.example: The lecture starts at nine o'clock.

mat-a2-uebung.example: In the exercise class we work through problems.

mat-a2-beispiel.note: At Austrian universities “ein Beispiel rechnen” = to solve a problem.
mat-a2-beispiel.example: By tomorrow we have to solve five problems.

mat-a2-wurzel.example: The square root of nine is three.

mat-a2-esgilt.note: A typical lecture phrase: “Für alle x gilt …” — for all x it holds that …

mat-a2-darausfolgt.example: x equals two, so it follows that x² = 4.

mat-a21-02-grundwert.note: The three quantities of a percentage problem: Grundwert (G), Prozentsatz (p %), Prozentwert (W).
mat-a21-02-grundwert.example: The old price is the base value.

mat-a21-02-prozentsatz.example: Here the percentage is thirty per cent.

mat-a21-02-prozentwert.tr: percentage value (the part of the whole)

mat-a21-02-dreisatz.note: Three steps: 100 % → 1 % → the percentage you need.
mat-a21-02-dreisatz.example: With the rule of three we first work out one per cent.

mat-a21-02-reduziert.note: Verb: reduzieren — to reduce. On signs: “Reduziert!”
mat-a21-02-reduziert.example: The jacket is reduced by thirty per cent.

mat-a21-02-ermaessigung.note: For pupils and students: die Schülerermäßigung, die Studentenermäßigung.
mat-a21-02-ermaessigung.example: With your student card you get a discount.

mat-a21-02-mehrwertsteuer.example: Twenty per cent VAT is included in the price.

mat-a21-02-erhoehen.note: um + Akk erhöhen — by how much; auf + Akk — to what value.
mat-a21-02-erhoehen.example: The shop raises its prices by five per cent.

mat-a21-02-zins.note: Almost always plural: die Zinsen. Zinsen bekommen / zahlen.
mat-a21-02-zins.example: The bank pays me two per cent interest.

mat-a21-02-zinssatz.example: The interest rate is low at the moment.

mat-a21-02-sparbuch.example: Grandma opened a savings account for Paul.

mat-a21-02-anlegen.note: Geld anlegen — to invest money. Also: eine Datei anlegen — to create a file.
mat-a21-02-anlegen.example: Paul invests 1000 euros for a year.

mat-a21-02-guthaben.note: Also: das Guthaben auf der Handykarte — phone credit.
mat-a21-02-guthaben.example: After a year the balance is 1020 euros.

mat-a21-02-kredit.note: einen Kredit aufnehmen — to take out a loan.
mat-a21-02-kredit.example: Many people take out a loan for a car.

mat-a21-02-zuwachs.example: The increase is only twenty euros.

mat-a21-03-koordinatensystem.example: We plot the points in a coordinate system.

mat-a21-03-achse.note: die x-Achse — x-axis, die y-Achse — y-axis.
mat-a21-03-achse.example: Time goes on the horizontal axis.

mat-a21-03-ursprung.note: The point (0|0). In Austria coordinates are written with a bar: P(2|3).
mat-a21-03-ursprung.example: The line goes through the origin.

mat-a21-03-gerade-noun.note: A noun! die Gerade — straight line; gerade (adj.) — straight, even.
mat-a21-03-gerade-noun.example: The graph of a linear function is a straight line.

mat-a21-03-steigung.note: In Austria: y = k·x + d, k — slope, d — y-intercept.

mat-a21-03-schnittpunkt.example: Where is the point of intersection of the two lines?

mat-a21-03-linear.example: The growth is linear: the same amount every month.

mat-a21-03-proportional.example: The price is proportional to the quantity.

mat-a21-03-graph.note: Weak declension: den Graphen, des Graphen. Also written Graf.
mat-a21-03-graph.example: The graph rises to the right.

mat-a21-03-wertetabelle.example: First we make a table of values.

mat-a21-03-zuordnen.note: A function ordnet jedem x genau ein y zu. Noun: die Zuordnung.
mat-a21-03-zuordnen.example: The function assigns a price to each minute.

mat-a21-03-abhaengig.note: von + Dat abhängig sein — to depend on.
mat-a21-03-abhaengig.example: The price depends on the minutes.

mat-a21-03-grundgebuehr.example: Plan A has a basic fee of ten euros.

mat-a21-03-guenstig.example: For people who phone a lot, plan A is cheaper.

mat-a21-03-steil.note: The bigger the Steigung, the steiler die Gerade.
mat-a21-03-steil.example: The line of plan B is steeper.

mat-a21-04-potenz.note: Read as: zwei hoch drei (2³) — two to the power of three.
mat-a21-04-potenz.example: Two to the power of three is a power.

mat-a21-04-basis.example: In two to the power of three, the two is the base.

mat-a21-04-exponent.example: The exponent is at the top right.

mat-a21-04-quadrieren.note: A verb in -ieren: Perfekt without ge-.
mat-a21-04-quadrieren.example: If you square five, you get twenty-five.

mat-a21-04-zehnerpotenz.note: Große Zahlen schreibt man mit Zehnerpotenzen: 3 · 10⁶.
mat-a21-04-zehnerpotenz.example: Ten to the power of six is a power of ten.

mat-a21-04-negativ.example: Minus eight is a negative number.

mat-a21-04-positiv.note: Also in everyday life: positiv denken — to think positively.
mat-a21-04-positiv.example: The square of a number is never negative, but positive or zero.

mat-a21-04-verdoppeln.example: The number of bacteria doubles every twenty minutes.

mat-a21-04-wachsen.note: Strong verb with umlaut: du wächst, er wächst. Perfekt with sein.

mat-a21-04-wachstum.note: lineares Wachstum — linear growth, exponentielles Wachstum — exponential growth.

mat-a21-04-zeitraum.example: A lot happens in a short period of time.

mat-a21-04-groessenordnung.example: That's a number of the order of ten to the power of twenty-one.

mat-a21-05-zufall.note: Was für ein Zufall! — What a coincidence!
mat-a21-05-zufall.example: When you roll a dice, chance decides.

mat-a21-05-zufaellig.example: We choose a card at random.

mat-a21-05-wuerfeln.note: eine Sechs würfeln — to roll a six.

mat-a21-05-augenzahl.note: The dots on a dice are called Augen — “eyes”.

mat-a21-05-wahrscheinlichkeit.note: Written as a fraction or a percentage: 1/6 ≈ 17 %.
mat-a21-05-wahrscheinlichkeit.example: The probability of a six is one sixth.

mat-a21-05-wahrscheinlich.example: The game will probably go on for a long time.

mat-a21-05-unmoeglich.note: ein unmögliches Ereignis — an impossible event (probability 0).

mat-a21-05-sicher.note: ein sicheres Ereignis — a certain event (probability 1).
mat-a21-05-sicher.example: It's certain that the number is less than seven.

mat-a21-05-ereignis.note: Plural with double s: die Ereignisse.

mat-a21-05-versuch.note: In maths: das Zufallsexperiment, ein Versuch — one trial.
mat-a21-05-versuch.example: On the third try Max wins.

mat-a21-05-gluecksrad.example: The wheel of fortune has eight sections of equal size.

mat-a21-05-los.note: das Los entscheidet — it's decided by drawing lots.

mat-a21-05-ziehen.note: Strong verb: zog – gezogen. ein Los ziehen — to draw a ticket.

mat-a21-05-gewinnchance.note: Chance is pronounced the French way: “SHAHN-seh”.
mat-a21-05-gewinnchance.example: The chance of winning is twenty-five per cent.

mat-a21-05-treffer.example: Among the tickets there are fifty winners.

mat-a21-05-niete.note: Said of a person: eine Niete — a loser, a dud.
mat-a21-05-niete.example: Unfortunately my ticket was a blank.

mat-a21-06-umfrage.note: eine Umfrage machen / durchführen — to carry out a survey.
mat-a21-06-umfrage.example: The school newspaper is doing a survey.

mat-a21-06-fragebogen.note: der Bogen — sheet (of paper); in Austria plural Fragebögen.
mat-a21-06-fragebogen.example: Everyone gets a questionnaire with five questions.

mat-a21-06-stichprobe.note: Not everyone, just a part: 60 aus 600.
mat-a21-06-stichprobe.example: Sixty people are a sample out of six hundred.

mat-a21-06-repraesentativ.example: Surveying only one class isn't representative.

mat-a21-06-haeufigkeit.note: absolute Häufigkeit — how many times, relative Häufigkeit — proportion.
mat-a21-06-haeufigkeit.example: The answer “seven hours” has the highest frequency.

mat-a21-06-kreisdiagramm.example: We show the result in a pie chart.

mat-a21-06-auswerten.example: At the weekend we analyse the questionnaires.

mat-a21-06-mittelwert.note: Synonyms: der Durchschnitt, das arithmetische Mittel.
mat-a21-06-mittelwert.example: Here the mean is over forty euros.

mat-a21-06-median.note: The value in the middle of an ordered list.
mat-a21-06-median.example: The median is the value in the middle.

mat-a21-06-spannweite.note: The largest value minus the smallest.

mat-a21-06-ausreisser.note: ausreißen — to break away, to run off.
mat-a21-06-ausreisser.example: One outlier can change the mean a lot.

mat-a21-06-sortieren.example: First we sort the values by size.

mat-a21-06-verfaelschen.example: A single value distorts the result.

mat-a21-06-aussagekraeftig.example: Here the median is more meaningful.

mat-a21-06-datenreihe.example: The data set has seven values.

mat-a21-07-quader.note: A Würfel is a special case of a Quader with equal edges.
mat-a21-07-quader.example: An aquarium is often shaped like a cuboid.

mat-a21-07-volumen.example: The volume is base area times height.

mat-a21-07-hoehe.note: hoch → die Höhe. In der Höhe — up high.
mat-a21-07-hoehe.example: The height of the aquarium is 40 centimetres.

mat-a21-07-kubikzentimeter.example: A litre has a thousand cubic centimetres.

mat-a21-07-oberflaeche.example: For the surface area we add up all the faces.

mat-a21-07-netz.note: In geometry: das Netz eines Würfels — the net of a cube.
mat-a21-07-netz.example: Draw the net of the cuboid.

mat-a21-07-fuellen.note: etwas mit + Dat füllen — to fill something with something.
mat-a21-07-fuellen.example: We fill the aquarium with water.

mat-a21-07-zylinder.example: A tin has the shape of a cylinder.

mat-a21-07-kegel.example: The ice cream cone is a cone.

mat-a21-07-pyramide.example: The pyramid has a square base.

mat-a21-07-radius.example: The radius is half the diameter.

mat-a21-07-durchmesser.example: The tin has a diameter of eight centimetres.

mat-a21-07-fassen.note: Also: to grasp, to understand (Ich kann es nicht fassen — I can't believe it).
mat-a21-07-fassen.example: The tin holds half a litre.

mat-a21-07-pi.example: For the circle we need the number pi.

mat-a21-07-formel.example: The formula for the volume is in the exercise book.

mat-a21-08-matura.note: In Germany — das Abitur. Officially: die Reifeprüfung. You need it to go to university.
mat-a21-08-matura.example: Without the Matura you can't study at TU Wien.

mat-a21-08-formelsammlung.note: The official Formelsammlung is allowed in the Austrian Matura.
mat-a21-08-formelsammlung.example: You're allowed to use the formula booklet.

mat-a21-08-grundkompetenz.note: Teil 1 der Mathe-Matura prüft die Grundkompetenzen.
mat-a21-08-grundkompetenz.example: The first part is about basic competences.

mat-a21-08-notenschluessel.example: According to the grading scale you need 36 points for a “good”.

mat-a21-08-zeitdruck.note: unter Zeitdruck stehen — to be under time pressure.
mat-a21-08-zeitdruck.example: In the second part Sophie comes under time pressure.

mat-a21-08-sich-konzentrieren.example: Sophie concentrates on the next task.

mat-a21-08-bestehen.note: eine Prüfung bestehen — to pass. False friend: “bestehen aus” — to consist of.

mat-a21-08-kompensationspruefung.tr: compensation exam (oral resit after a failed written Matura)
mat-a21-08-kompensationspruefung.note: An Austrian concept. Short: die Kompensation, “Kompi”.
mat-a21-08-kompensationspruefung.example: After the “fail” David has an oral compensation exam.

mat-a21-08-durchfallen.note: Perfekt with sein. bei der Prüfung durchfallen.

mat-a21-08-sich-vorbereiten.note: sich auf + Akk vorbereiten — to prepare for something.

mat-a21-08-lernplan.example: His study plan has one topic for each day.

mat-a21-08-zusammenfassung.example: He writes a summary for each topic.

mat-a21-08-stoff.note: der Prüfungsstoff — the material for the exam.
mat-a21-08-stoff.example: Four years' worth of material is a lot.

mat-a21-09-textaufgabe.example: Many students are afraid of word problems.

mat-a21-09-angabe.note: In Austria die Angabe = the statement of a problem. Also: Angaben machen — to give details.
mat-a21-09-angabe.example: Read the problem statement carefully twice.

mat-a21-09-gegeben.note: Participle of geben. In a solution you write: Gegeben: …, Gesucht: …
mat-a21-09-gegeben.example: The length and the width are given.

mat-a21-09-gesucht.example: Find the perimeter of the garden.

mat-a21-09-unterstreichen.note: Inseparable prefix: ich unterstreiche. Strong: unterstrich – unterstrichen.
mat-a21-09-unterstreichen.example: Jakob underlines all the numbers in the problem.

mat-a21-09-ansatz.note: A teacher may say: Der Ansatz ist richtig — the approach is correct.
mat-a21-09-ansatz.example: The approach is correct, but the result is wrong.

mat-a21-09-antwortsatz.tr: answer sentence (answer in a full sentence)
mat-a21-09-antwortsatz.note: In Austrian schools you lose points without an Antwortsatz.
mat-a21-09-antwortsatz.example: At the end Jakob writes his answer in a full sentence.

mat-a21-09-geschwindigkeit.note: v = s / t. Speed = distance divided by time.
mat-a21-09-geschwindigkeit.example: Their speed is eighteen kilometres per hour.

mat-a21-09-strecke.note: In geometry die Strecke AB — the line segment AB.
mat-a21-09-strecke.example: The distance to Krems is 45 kilometres.

mat-a21-09-fahrzeit.example: The journey time is two and a half hours.

mat-a21-09-stundenkilometer.note: Colloquial. More precisely: Kilometer pro Stunde (km/h).
mat-a21-09-stundenkilometer.example: In town you're only allowed to drive at fifty kilometres per hour.

mat-a21-09-umrechnen.note: in + Akk umrechnen: Stunden in Minuten umrechnen.
mat-a21-09-umrechnen.example: We convert the hours into minutes.

mat-a21-09-ueberschlagen.note: Inseparable prefix: ich überschlage. Noun: die Überschlagsrechnung — rough estimate.
mat-a21-09-ueberschlagen.example: First Lea estimates the result in her head.

mat-a21-09-sinnvoll.example: Twenty-five hours for 45 kilometres doesn't make sense.

mat-a21-10-studiengang.note: In Austria more often: das Studium, e.g. das Bachelorstudium Technische Mathematik.
mat-a21-10-studiengang.example: Which degree programme did you choose?

mat-a21-10-bachelor.note: Pronounced as in English. Bachelor → Master → Doktorat.

mat-a21-10-zulassung.note: zulassen — to admit. International students also need a German certificate.
mat-a21-10-zulassung.example: For admission you need the Matura.

mat-a21-10-vorkurs.example: In September there's a preparatory course in mathematics.

mat-a21-10-studienanfaenger.note: Feminine: die Studienanfängerin. Colloquially in Austria: Erstsemestrige.
mat-a21-10-studienanfaenger.example: The preparatory course is for first-year students.

mat-a21-10-lehramt.note: Lehramt studieren — to train as a teacher.
mat-a21-10-lehramt.example: David is training to teach maths and physics.

mat-a21-10-semester.note: das Wintersemester (October — January), das Sommersemester (March — June).

mat-a21-10-uebungsblatt.example: Every week there's a new problem sheet.

mat-a21-10-tutor.tr: tutor (older student who runs exercise classes)
mat-a21-10-tutor.note: Feminine: die Tutorin. Stress: TU-tor, plural Tu-TO-ren.
mat-a21-10-tutor.example: Our tutor is in his fifth semester.

mat-a21-10-uebungsgruppe.example: In the exercise group we present the solutions.

mat-a21-10-abgeben.example: We have to hand in the sheet by Monday.

mat-a21-10-frist.note: die Frist einhalten — to meet the deadline; die Frist verpassen — to miss the deadline.
mat-a21-10-frist.example: The deadline is Monday at ten o'clock.

mat-a21-10-skriptum.note: An Austrian word. In Germany: das Skript.
mat-a21-10-skriptum.example: The lecture notes have two hundred pages.

mat-a21-10-anstrengend.note: sich anstrengen — to make an effort.
mat-a21-10-anstrengend.example: The first weeks are very demanding.

mat-a21-10-mathematiker.example: A good mathematician doesn't give up quickly.

cyb-a22-vorfall.example: Yesterday there was an incident in the data centre.

cyb-a22-logdatei.example: Every login is recorded in the log file.

cyb-a22-untersuchen.note: Here the prefix unter- is inseparable: er untersucht, hat untersucht.
cyb-a22-untersuchen.example: The team is investigating the attack.

cyb-a22-verdaechtig.example: The firewall reports a suspicious connection.

cyb-a22-datenverkehr.example: At night the traffic was unusually high.

cyb-a22-port.example: This port is open and insecure.

cyb-a22-ipadresse.example: Where does this IP address come from?

cyb-a22-berechtigung.note: Often plural: die Berechtigungen. Berechtigung für + Akk.
cyb-a22-berechtigung.example: You don't have permission for this folder.

cyb-a22-vergeben.note: vergeben an + Akk: to assign to someone. The prefix ver- is inseparable. Second meaning — “to forgive”.

cyb-a22-administrator.note: Colloquially: der Admin. Feminine: die Administratorin.
cyb-a22-administrator.example: Only the administrator may install programs.

cyb-a22-sicherheitsrichtlinie.example: Every employee has to read the security policy.

cyb-a22-einhalten.tr: to comply with, to stick to

cyb-a22-verstoss.note: Verstoß gegen + Akk: a breach of something.
cyb-a22-verstoss.example: That's a breach of the security policy.

cyb-a22-verhindern.example: A strong password prevents many attacks.

cyb-a22-risiko.example: Old software is a big risk.

cyb-a22-02-schluessel.note: Der öffentliche Schlüssel — public key; der private (geheime) Schlüssel — private key.
cyb-a22-02-schluessel.example: Without the key nobody can read the file.

cyb-a22-02-entschluesseln.note: The prefix ent- is inseparable. Opposite — verschlüsseln.
cyb-a22-02-entschluesseln.example: The recipient decrypts the message with their key.

cyb-a22-02-klartext.note: Im Klartext — in plaintext; in everyday German also “to put it plainly”.
cyb-a22-02-klartext.example: You must never store passwords in plaintext.

cyb-a22-02-geheimtext.example: The ciphertext looks like random characters.

cyb-a22-02-symmetrisch.note: Symmetrische Verschlüsselung — one shared key; asymmetrische — a key pair.
cyb-a22-02-symmetrisch.example: In symmetric encryption there is only one key.

cyb-a22-02-schluesselpaar.note: Consists of a öffentlicher Schlüssel (public) and a privater Schlüssel (private).
cyb-a22-02-schluesselpaar.example: Each user generates their own key pair.

cyb-a22-02-algorithmus.example: AES is a well-known encryption algorithm.

cyb-a22-02-austauschen.note: Separable prefix aus-. Etwas mit jemandem austauschen — to exchange something with someone.
cyb-a22-02-austauschen.example: The two servers first exchange a key.

cyb-a22-02-signatur.example: The program checks the file's signature.

cyb-a22-02-signieren.note: + Akk. On paper more often unterschreiben.
cyb-a22-02-signieren.example: The company signs every update with its key.

cyb-a22-02-hashwert.note: Also: der Hash. Die Hashfunktion — hash function.
cyb-a22-02-hashwert.example: Even a small change changes the whole hash.

cyb-a22-02-integritaet.note: No plural. The three goals of infosec: Vertraulichkeit, Integrität, Verfügbarkeit.
cyb-a22-02-integritaet.example: We check the integrity of the data with the hash.

cyb-a22-02-echtheit.note: From echt — genuine. No plural. Technical term: die Authentizität.
cyb-a22-02-echtheit.example: The signature proves the document's authenticity.

cyb-a22-02-manipulieren.example: Someone tampered with the file on the way.

cyb-a22-02-zertifizierungsstelle.example: A certificate authority confirms who the key belongs to.

cyb-a22-03-trojaner.note: From the Trojan horse (das Trojanische Pferd): it looks like a useful program.
cyb-a22-03-trojaner.example: The Trojan looked like an ordinary game.

cyb-a22-03-wurm.note: Unlike a virus, a worm spreads over the network by itself, without the user's help.
cyb-a22-03-wurm.example: A worm doesn't need any help from the user.

cyb-a22-03-ransomware.note: An anglicism, feminine (like die Software). Usually no plural.
cyb-a22-03-ransomware.example: The ransomware encrypted all the files.

cyb-a22-03-keylogger.example: A keylogger records every key you press.

cyb-a22-03-infizieren.note: mit + Dat: mit einem Virus infiziert — infected with a virus.
cyb-a22-03-infizieren.example: The laptop was infected via a USB stick.

cyb-a22-03-sichverbreiten.note: Reflexive; the prefix ver- is inseparable. sich über + Akk verbreiten — to spread via something.
cyb-a22-03-sichverbreiten.example: The worm spreads over the network.

cyb-a22-03-loesegeld.note: Usually no plural. Lösegeld fordern / zahlen — to demand / pay a ransom.
cyb-a22-03-loesegeld.example: The attackers demand a ransom in bitcoin.

cyb-a22-03-sichtarnen.note: sich tarnen als + Nom.: to pose as something.
cyb-a22-03-sichtarnen.example: The malware poses as a harmless update.

cyb-a22-03-virenscanner.note: Viren — plural of Virus. Synonym: das Antivirenprogramm.
cyb-a22-03-virenscanner.example: The virus scanner found a dangerous file.

cyb-a22-03-entdecken.note: The prefix ent- is inseparable; + Akk.
cyb-a22-03-entdecken.example: The company only discovered the attack after weeks.

cyb-a22-03-quarantaene.example: The scanner moves suspicious files to quarantine.

cyb-a22-03-sandbox.note: An anglicism; descriptively: eine isolierte Umgebung.
cyb-a22-03-sandbox.example: In the sandbox the program can't do any damage.

cyb-a22-03-hintertuer.example: The Trojan opens a backdoor for the attackers.

cyb-a22-03-schadcode.note: Usually no plural. Schad- from der Schaden — damage.
cyb-a22-03-schadcode.example: Malicious code was hidden in the attachment.

cyb-a22-03-bereinigen.note: The prefix be- is inseparable; + Akk.
cyb-a22-03-bereinigen.example: After the attack we had to clean all the computers.

cyb-a22-03-verhalten.note: No plural. Verhaltensbasierte Erkennung — behaviour-based detection.
cyb-a22-03-verhalten.example: The scanner looks at a program's behaviour.

cyb-a22-04-injection.note: An anglicism. Die SQL-Injection — SQL injection.
cyb-a22-04-injection.example: Injection is a very common vulnerability.

cyb-a22-04-formular.example: Please fill in the form completely.

cyb-a22-04-eingabefeld.example: The attacker writes code into the input field.

cyb-a22-04-anfuehrungszeichen.note: More often plural. German text uses „like this“.
cyb-a22-04-anfuehrungszeichen.example: A single quotation mark can break the query.

cyb-a22-04-filtern.note: + Akk; etwas aus + Dat filtern — to filter something out of something.
cyb-a22-04-filtern.example: The server filters dangerous characters out of the input.

cyb-a22-04-maskieren.example: We escape every quotation mark with a backslash.

cyb-a22-04-datenbank.example: All user accounts are stored in a database.

cyb-a22-04-einschleusen.note: Separable prefix ein-; etwas in + Akk einschleusen.
cyb-a22-04-einschleusen.example: The hacker injects his own code into the query.

cyb-a22-04-sitzung.note: In IT often die Session. Another meaning — meeting.
cyb-a22-04-sitzung.example: After logging in a new session begins.

cyb-a22-04-eingabepruefung.example: Without input validation the form is dangerous.

cyb-a22-04-skript.note: Plural also die Skripts. Second meaning — lecture notes.
cyb-a22-04-skript.example: The script runs in the victim's browser.

cyb-a22-04-ausfuehren.note: Separable prefix aus-; + Akk: Code ausführen.
cyb-a22-04-ausfuehren.example: The browser simply runs the foreign script.

cyb-a22-04-ablaufen.note: Separable prefix ab-; Perfekt with sein.
cyb-a22-04-ablaufen.example: After half an hour the session expires.

cyb-a22-04-webanwendung.note: Die Anwendung — application. Synonym: die Web-App.
cyb-a22-04-webanwendung.example: Our web application stores the students' data.

cyb-a22-04-anfrage.note: Eine Anfrage an + Akk schicken — to send a request to someone/something.
cyb-a22-04-anfrage.example: The browser sends a request to the server.

cyb-a22-05-authentifizierung.note: Checking who you are. Don't confuse with Autorisierung — what you're allowed to do.
cyb-a22-05-authentifizierung.example: Authentication takes only a few seconds.

cyb-a22-05-anmeldedaten.example: Never give out your login credentials on the phone!

cyb-a22-05-token.note: A digital “pass” after logging in; also a hardware key (Hardware-Token).
cyb-a22-05-token.example: After logging in the browser gets a token.

cyb-a22-05-ueberpruefen.note: Here the prefix über- is inseparable; + Akk.
cyb-a22-05-ueberpruefen.example: The server checks the password first.

cyb-a22-05-identitaet.example: You prove your identity with the code.

cyb-a22-05-einmalpasswort.example: The app shows a new one-time password.

cyb-a22-05-gueltig.example: This code is no longer valid.

cyb-a22-05-sicherheitsschluessel.example: I log in with a security key.

cyb-a22-05-autorisierung.note: Decides what you're allowed to do, after authentication.
cyb-a22-05-autorisierung.example: Authorisation determines what you're allowed to do.

cyb-a22-05-rolle.example: Each user has exactly one role.

cyb-a22-05-zuweisen.example: The admin assigns me a new role.

cyb-a22-05-zugriffsrecht.note: Zugriff + s + Recht; more often plural.
cyb-a22-05-zugriffsrecht.example: Guests have only a few access rights.

cyb-a22-05-prinzip.note: das Prinzip der minimalen Rechte — the principle of least privilege.

cyb-a22-05-anfordern.example: I request the rights in writing.

cyb-a22-05-eingeschraenkt.note: From the verb einschränken — to restrict.
cyb-a22-05-eingeschraenkt.example: With this account, access is restricted.

cyb-a22-05-biometrisch.note: Fingerabdruck und Gesicht sind biometrische Merkmale.
cyb-a22-05-biometrisch.example: The phone uses a biometric method.

cyb-a22-06-penetrationstest.note: Colloquially: der Pentest. The person doing it — der Pentester.
cyb-a22-06-penetrationstest.collocation: to carry out a penetration test
cyb-a22-06-penetrationstest.example: The bank has a penetration test done every year.

cyb-a22-06-auftrag.note: der Auftraggeber — client. im Auftrag von + Dat — on behalf of.
cyb-a22-06-auftrag.example: We only work with a clear assignment.

cyb-a22-06-umfang.note: In a pentest — the scope: what exactly may be tested.
cyb-a22-06-umfang.example: The scope is set out exactly in the contract.

cyb-a22-06-erlaubt.example: A test without a contract is not allowed.

cyb-a22-06-vertrag.example: First both sides have to read the contract.

cyb-a22-06-vereinbaren.note: The prefix ver- is inseparable; + Akk: einen Termin vereinbaren.
cyb-a22-06-vereinbaren.example: We agree on the rules before the test.

cyb-a22-06-zielsystem.example: The web server is the most important target system.

cyb-a22-06-unterschrift.note: From unterschreiben — to sign. A digital signature is die Signatur.
cyb-a22-06-unterschrift.example: We don't start without a signature.

cyb-a22-06-bericht.example: The client reads the report very carefully.

cyb-a22-06-scannen.note: + Akk: das Netzwerk scannen, Ports scannen.
cyb-a22-06-scannen.example: First she scans all the open ports.

cyb-a22-06-feststellen.tr: to establish, to find, to determine
cyb-a22-06-feststellen.note: Separable prefix; often + dass: Wir stellen fest, dass …
cyb-a22-06-feststellen.example: We find that the software is outdated.

cyb-a22-06-schweregrad.example: This vulnerability has a high severity.

cyb-a22-06-empfehlung.example: Our recommendation is an immediate update.

cyb-a22-06-auftraggeber.example: At the end the client gets a report.

cyb-a22-06-zusammenfassung.example: The boss only reads the summary.

cyb-a22-06-schwachstellenscan.example: On the first day we do a vulnerability scan.

cyb-a22-07-notfallplan.example: Every company needs a good emergency plan.

cyb-a22-07-isolieren.note: Verbs in -ieren have no ge- in the participle: hat isoliert.
cyb-a22-07-isolieren.example: We isolate the infected computer immediately.

cyb-a22-07-eindaemmen.note: Separable prefix; der Damm — dam. IR term: Eindämmung (containment).
cyb-a22-07-eindaemmen.example: The team quickly contains the attack.

cyb-a22-07-ursache.example: The cause was a weak password.

cyb-a22-07-ausfall.note: From ausfallen — to fail, to go down.
cyb-a22-07-ausfall.example: The outage lasted the whole morning.

cyb-a22-07-betroffen.note: von etwas betroffen sein — to be affected by something.
cyb-a22-07-betroffen.example: The mail server is affected too.

cyb-a22-07-trennen.note: etwas vom Netz trennen — to disconnect from the network.
cyb-a22-07-trennen.example: Disconnect the laptop from the network immediately!

cyb-a22-07-sofortmassnahme.example: The first immediate action is in the plan.

cyb-a22-07-spur.example: The attacker left hardly any traces.

cyb-a22-07-forensik.example: For forensics we need a copy of the hard drive.

cyb-a22-07-wiederanlauf.example: After the analysis we plan the systems' recovery.

cyb-a22-07-zeitpunkt.note: zu diesem Zeitpunkt — at this point.
cyb-a22-07-zeitpunkt.example: At that moment nobody was in the office.

cyb-a22-07-ausmass.note: Usually no plural: das Ausmaß des Schadens.
cyb-a22-07-ausmass.example: The scale of the attack was large.

cyb-a22-07-neu-aufsetzen.note: Separable prefix: Wir setzen den Server neu auf.

cyb-a22-07-lehre.note: Lehren aus etwas ziehen — to learn lessons from something. Second meaning: apprenticeship (eine Lehre machen).
cyb-a22-07-lehre.example: We learn an important lesson from this.

cyb-a22-07-vorbeugen.note: Separable prefix; + Dat: einem Angriff vorbeugen.

cyb-a22-08-dsgvo.note: Short for die Datenschutz-Grundverordnung. No plural. Used in both Germany and Austria.
cyb-a22-08-dsgvo.example: The GDPR applies throughout the EU.

cyb-a22-08-personenbezogen.tr: personal (of data), relating to a specific person
cyb-a22-08-personenbezogen.note: Person + en + bezogen (related). Almost always in personenbezogene Daten.
cyb-a22-08-personenbezogen.example: Name and address are personal data.

cyb-a22-08-verarbeiten.note: The prefix ver- is inseparable. Under the GDPR “processing” (die Verarbeitung) is anything done with data: collecting, storing, sharing, deleting.
cyb-a22-08-verarbeiten.example: The company processes its customers' data.

cyb-a22-08-verantwortliche.note: An adjectival noun: der Verantwortliche, ein Verantwortlicher. Under the GDPR — whoever decides why and how data is processed (often a company).
cyb-a22-08-verantwortliche.example: The controller has to protect the data.

cyb-a22-08-betroffene.note: An adjectival noun: der/die Betroffene, ein Betroffener. Under the GDPR — the person whose data is processed (die betroffene Person).

cyb-a22-08-zweck.note: A GDPR principle: die Zweckbindung — data is only used for the stated purpose.
cyb-a22-08-zweck.example: For what purpose do you need my data?

cyb-a22-08-rechtsgrundlage.note: Recht + s + Grundlage (basis). Rechtsgrundlage für + Akk.
cyb-a22-08-rechtsgrundlage.example: Without a legal basis, processing is forbidden.

cyb-a22-08-zulaessig.note: Opposite: unzulässig. More formal than erlaubt.
cyb-a22-08-zulaessig.example: Is a camera in the office permissible?

cyb-a22-08-datenpanne.note: Die Panne — breakdown, mishap. The official GDPR term: Verletzung des Schutzes personenbezogener Daten.
cyb-a22-08-datenpanne.example: After the data breach many customers were furious.

cyb-a22-08-datenschutzbeauftragte.note: An adjectival noun: der Datenschutzbeauftragte, ein Datenschutzbeauftragter; a woman — die Datenschutzbeauftragte.
cyb-a22-08-datenschutzbeauftragte.example: Best ask our data protection officer.

cyb-a22-08-aufsichtsbehoerde.note: Die Aufsicht — supervision, die Behörde — authority. In Austria it's die Datenschutzbehörde (DSB).
cyb-a22-08-aufsichtsbehoerde.collocation: to complain to the supervisory authority
cyb-a22-08-aufsichtsbehoerde.example: The supervisory authority examines the complaint.

cyb-a22-08-bussgeld.note: Die Buße — penance, penalty. In the GDPR text: die Geldbuße; colloquially just die Strafe.
cyb-a22-08-bussgeld.example: The company had to pay a large fine.

cyb-a22-08-auskunft.note: Auskunft über + Akk. Das Auskunftsrecht — the right of access to your stored data.
cyb-a22-08-auskunft.example: Everyone may request information about their data.

cyb-a22-08-loeschung.note: From löschen. Das Recht auf Löschung — the “right to be forgotten”.
cyb-a22-08-loeschung.example: She has requested the deletion of her account.

cyb-a22-08-widersprechen.note: widersprechen + Dat: der Werbung widersprechen. Here the prefix wider- is inseparable.
cyb-a22-08-widersprechen.example: I object to the use of my data.

cyb-a22-08-anonymisieren.note: A verb in -ieren: participle without ge-. Compare pseudonymisieren — to replace a name with a code.
cyb-a22-08-anonymisieren.example: For the study we anonymise all the names.

cyb-a22-09-wettbewerb.example: The competition lasts the whole weekend.

cyb-a22-09-teilnehmen.note: Separable prefix; teilnehmen an + Dat: an einem Wettbewerb teilnehmen.
cyb-a22-09-teilnehmen.collocation: to take part in a competition
cyb-a22-09-teilnehmen.example: Last year we took part in the competition.

cyb-a22-09-team.note: Pronounced as in English. In sport also: die Mannschaft.

cyb-a22-09-flagge.tr: flag (in a CTF — the secret answer string)
cyb-a22-09-flagge.note: In a CTF a flag is a string like flag{…} that you have to find and submit. In the everyday sense also: die Fahne.
cyb-a22-09-flagge.example: The flag was hidden in a picture.

cyb-a22-09-raetsel.note: Plural is the same: die Rätsel.

cyb-a22-09-hinweis.note: Hinweis auf + Akk. In CTFs often in English: der Hint.
cyb-a22-09-hinweis.example: The hint helped us a lot.

cyb-a22-09-einreichen.note: Separable prefix; + Akk. Also: eine Arbeit, einen Antrag einreichen.
cyb-a22-09-einreichen.example: We submitted the flag at midnight.

cyb-a22-09-rangliste.note: Der Rang — rank. In CTFs often: das Scoreboard.
cyb-a22-09-rangliste.example: We're in third place on the leaderboard.

cyb-a22-09-binaerdatei.note: binär — binary, die Datei — file. Colloquially: das Binary.
cyb-a22-09-binaerdatei.example: The binary crashes with long input.

cyb-a22-09-pufferueberlauf.note: Der Puffer — buffer, der Überlauf — overflow. Often in English: der Buffer Overflow.
cyb-a22-09-pufferueberlauf.example: A buffer overflow can make the program crash.

cyb-a22-09-exploit.note: An anglicism; das Exploit also occurs, but der is more common. Verb: ausnutzen (eine Schwachstelle ausnutzen).
cyb-a22-09-exploit.example: His exploit worked on the first try.

cyb-a22-09-debugger.note: Plural is the same. Verb: debuggen (er debuggt · hat debuggt).
cyb-a22-09-debugger.example: In the debugger you can see every step.

cyb-a22-09-writeup.example: After the CTF I'm writing a write-up.

cyb-a22-09-loesungsweg.tr: solution path, how you solved it
cyb-a22-09-loesungsweg.note: Die Lösung + s + der Weg. In CTFs the description is called das Write-up.
cyb-a22-09-loesungsweg.collocation: to describe how you solved it
cyb-a22-09-loesungsweg.example: After the competition we describe how we solved it.

cyb-a22-09-dranbleiben.tr: to keep at it, not to give up
cyb-a22-09-dranbleiben.note: Colloquial, separable prefix dran-; dranbleiben an + Dat. Perfekt with sein.
cyb-a22-09-dranbleiben.example: He kept at it until the very end.

cyb-a22-09-fortschritt.note: More often plural: Fortschritte machen — to make progress.
cyb-a22-09-fortschritt.example: In one semester she made great progress.

cyb-a22-10-analyst.note: Weak declension: den/dem Analysten. A woman — die Analystin. For example: der SOC-Analyst.
cyb-a22-10-analyst.example: The analyst sits in front of six screens.

cyb-a22-10-schicht.note: Second meaning — layer. Die Nachtschicht — night shift; im Schichtdienst arbeiten — to work shifts.
cyb-a22-10-schicht.example: My shift starts at six o'clock.

cyb-a22-10-ueberwachen.note: Here the prefix über- is inseparable (stress on -wa-). Noun: die Überwachung.
cyb-a22-10-ueberwachen.example: We monitor the network around the clock.

cyb-a22-10-alarm.example: An alert came in the middle of the night.

cyb-a22-10-fehlalarm.note: fehl- = mistaken. In IT security the same as a false positive.
cyb-a22-10-fehlalarm.example: Luckily it was only a false alarm.

cyb-a22-10-ereignis.note: In logs and SIEM: das Sicherheitsereignis — security event.

cyb-a22-10-arbeitgeber.example: My employer pays for the certification.

cyb-a22-10-eskalieren.note: A verb in -ieren, participle without ge-. Second meaning — to get worse (der Streit ist eskaliert).
cyb-a22-10-eskalieren.example: In a real attack he escalates the case immediately.

cyb-a22-10-sich-bewerben.note: sich bewerben um + Akk (for a position), bei + Dat (to a company). The prefix be- is inseparable.
cyb-a22-10-sich-bewerben.example: I'm applying to a bank in Vienna.

cyb-a22-10-bewerbung.note: Bewerbung um + Akk / als + Nom: die Bewerbung als Analyst.
cyb-a22-10-bewerbung.example: His application was short but very good.

cyb-a22-10-stelle.note: Many meanings: place (an dieser Stelle). Die offene Stelle — vacancy.
cyb-a22-10-stelle.example: The bank is looking for someone for a new position.

cyb-a22-10-vorstellungsgespraech.note: Die Vorstellung (introduction) + s + das Gespräch. Synonym: das Bewerbungsgespräch.
cyb-a22-10-vorstellungsgespraech.example: Tomorrow I have a job interview.

cyb-a22-10-berufserfahrung.note: Der Beruf + s + die Erfahrung. Usually no plural.
cyb-a22-10-berufserfahrung.example: You don't need any work experience for this position.

cyb-a22-10-kenntnisse.note: In this sense plural only: Kenntnisse in + Dat (Kenntnisse in Linux). Singular die Kenntnis — “awareness”.
cyb-a22-10-kenntnisse.example: She has good knowledge of networking.

cyb-a22-10-zertifizierung.note: For example OSCP or Security+. The document itself — das Zertifikat.

cyb-a22-10-gehalt.note: Das Gehalt — salary of employees, der Lohn — wages. Don't confuse with der Gehalt — content (proportion of something).
cyb-a22-10-gehalt.example: For entry-level staff the salary is pretty good.

inf-a22-schleife.example: The loop goes through all the elements of the list.

inf-a22-bedingung.example: If the condition is true, the loop continues.

inf-a22-quellcode.note: Die Quelle — source. Usually no plural.
inf-a22-quellcode.example: Anyone can read the source code.

inf-a22-ausfuehren.tr: to run, to execute (a program, code)
inf-a22-ausfuehren.note: Separable prefix: er führt das Programm aus.

inf-a22-befehl.example: Enter the command in the terminal.

inf-a22-wert.note: Der Wert einer Variable — the value of a variable.
inf-a22-wert.example: The variable now has a new value.

inf-a22-datentyp.example: A text has a different data type from a number.

inf-a22-testen.example: We test the code before every update.

inf-a22-eingabe.note: Pair: die Eingabe ↔ die Ausgabe (input ↔ output).
inf-a22-eingabe.example: The program is waiting for input.

inf-a22-kommentar.example: A good comment explains the code.

inf-a22-kompilieren.example: You have to compile the code first.

inf-a22-abstuerzen.note: Separable prefix; Perfekt with sein: ist abgestürzt.

inf-a22-beheben.note: The prefix be- is inseparable; + Akk.

inf-a22-02-datenstruktur.example: For this task we need a suitable data structure.

inf-a22-02-liste.example: The list contains the names of all the students.

inf-a22-02-feld.note: In programming das Feld = a fixed-length array; people also say das Array.
inf-a22-02-feld.example: In Java an array has a fixed length.

inf-a22-02-index.note: Plural: die Indizes (usual in IT) or die Indexe.
inf-a22-02-index.example: The first index is zero, not one.

inf-a22-02-element.example: We add a new element at the end.

inf-a22-02-laenge.example: The length of the list keeps changing.

inf-a22-02-sortieren.note: sortieren nach + Dat: nach Namen sortieren — to sort by name.
inf-a22-02-sortieren.example: The program sorts the names alphabetically.

inf-a22-02-zugreifen.note: Separable prefix; zugreifen auf + Akk: auf ein Element zugreifen.
inf-a22-02-zugreifen.example: With the index you access elements directly.

inf-a22-02-stapel.note: In IT also der Stack. LIFO: last in, first out.
inf-a22-02-stapel.example: The last element on the stack comes out first.

inf-a22-02-warteschlange.note: warten (to wait) + die Schlange (snake; queue). In IT also die Queue, FIFO.
inf-a22-02-warteschlange.example: In a queue the first element is handled first.

inf-a22-02-baum.example: A tree stores data on several levels.

inf-a22-02-wurzel.note: In computer science trees are drawn upside down: the root is at the top.
inf-a22-02-wurzel.example: In computer science the root is at the very top.

inf-a22-02-zeiger.note: Zeiger auf + Akk: ein Zeiger auf den Knoten.
inf-a22-02-zeiger.example: The pointer points to the next node.

inf-a22-02-entfernen.note: The prefix ent- is inseparable; + Akk, entfernen aus + Dat.
inf-a22-02-entfernen.example: She removes the top element from the stack.

inf-a22-02-durchsuchen.note: Inseparable prefix: er durchsucht die Liste; durchsuchen nach + Dat.
inf-a22-02-durchsuchen.example: We search the tree for a name.

inf-a22-03-klasse.note: At school die Klasse is also a class, but in OOP it's a “template” for objects.

inf-a22-03-objekt.example: Each object has its own values.

inf-a22-03-attribut.example: The colour is an attribute of the bicycle.

inf-a22-03-konstruktor.example: The constructor sets the initial values.

inf-a22-03-erzeugen.note: The prefix er- is inseparable; + Akk. Synonym: erstellen.
inf-a22-03-erzeugen.example: We create three objects from one class.

inf-a22-03-vererben.tr: to pass on, to bequeath (in OOP)
inf-a22-03-vererben.note: etwas an + Akk vererben. Noun: die Vererbung — inheritance.
inf-a22-03-vererben.example: The class Tier passes its methods on to the class Hund.

inf-a22-03-erben.note: erben von + Dat: die Klasse erbt von Fahrrad.
inf-a22-03-erben.example: The class Auto inherits from the class Fahrzeug.

inf-a22-03-vererbung.example: Inheritance saves a lot of code.

inf-a22-03-oberklasse.example: Fahrzeug is the superclass of Auto.

inf-a22-03-unterklasse.example: A subclass can have new methods.

inf-a22-03-ueberschreiben.note: Inseparable prefix (stress on -schrei-): er überschreibt die Methode.
inf-a22-03-ueberschreiben.example: The subclass overrides the method fahren.

inf-a22-03-kapselung.note: From die Kapsel — capsule. Usually no plural.

inf-a22-03-rueckgabewert.example: The method has no return value.

inf-a22-04-versionsverwaltung.note: die Version + s + die Verwaltung (management). The best known is Git.
inf-a22-04-versionsverwaltung.example: Hardly any team works without version control today.

inf-a22-04-repository.note: Plural: die Repositorys or die Repositorien. Colloquially: das Repo.
inf-a22-04-repository.example: All the code is in one repository.

inf-a22-04-aenderung.example: Every change gets a short description.

inf-a22-04-commit.note: das Commit also occurs; verb: committen.
inf-a22-04-commit.example: I make a commit after every small task.

inf-a22-04-stand.note: auf dem neuesten Stand — up to date.
inf-a22-04-stand.example: I'm going back to yesterday's state.

inf-a22-04-pushen.example: In the evening she pushes her changes to the server.

inf-a22-04-vergleichen.note: Inseparable prefix ver-; vergleichen mit + Dat.
inf-a22-04-vergleichen.example: We compare the new file with the old one.

inf-a22-04-zuruecksetzen.note: Separable prefix: wir setzen den Code zurück; zurücksetzen auf + Akk.
inf-a22-04-zuruecksetzen.example: Sara rolls the project back to the last state.

inf-a22-04-zweig.note: Literally a tree branch. People also say der Branch.
inf-a22-04-zweig.example: We create a branch for every new feature.

inf-a22-04-hauptzweig.note: In Git usually called main or master.
inf-a22-04-hauptzweig.example: Only tested code goes on the main branch.

inf-a22-04-klonen.example: First Felix clones the repository onto his laptop.

inf-a22-04-zusammenfuehren.note: Separable prefix; zusammenführen mit + Dat. Colloquially: mergen.

mat-a22-08-konfidenzintervall.example: The number 0.5 isn't in the confidence interval.

mat-a22-09-fakultaet.note: n! — „n Fakultät“. Second meaning: die Fakultät für Mathematik — faculty of mathematics.

mat-a22-09-reihenfolge.example: In the lottery the order doesn't matter.

mat-a22-09-auswaehlen.example: We choose six numbers out of 45.

mat-a22-09-binomialkoeffizient.example: The binomial coefficient is read “n choose k”.

mat-a22-09-moeglichkeit.example: There are over eight million possibilities.

mat-a22-09-teiler.note: der größte gemeinsame Teiler (ggT) — greatest common divisor (GCD).
mat-a22-09-teiler.example: Three is a divisor of twelve.

mat-a22-09-teilbar.note: durch + Akk teilbar: 84 ist durch 7 teilbar.

mat-a22-09-primfaktorzerlegung.example: The prime factorisation of 84 is two times two times three times seven.

mat-a22-09-euklidisch.note: der euklidische Algorithmus — the Euclidean algorithm.
mat-a22-09-euklidisch.example: You find the GCD with the Euclidean algorithm.

mat-a22-09-kongruent.example: Seventeen is congruent to two modulo five.

mat-a22-09-restklasse.example: Modulo five there are five residue classes.

mat-a22-10-klausur.note: In Austria people often say die Prüfung or die schriftliche Prüfung.
mat-a22-10-klausur.example: The written exam takes three hours.

mat-a22-10-pruefungstermin.example: The first exam date is at the end of January.

mat-a22-10-sich-anmelden.note: sich für + Akk / zu + Dat anmelden. Opposite: sich abmelden.
mat-a22-10-sich-anmelden.example: Sophie registers for the exam online.

mat-a22-10-altklausur.example: Past papers are good for practising.

mat-a22-10-lerngruppe.example: Our study group meets in the library.

mat-a22-10-lehrveranstaltung.note: Abbreviation: LVA (in Austria). Lectures, exercise classes and seminars are all Lehrveranstaltungen.

mat-a22-10-ects-punkt.note: Pronounced “ay-tsay-tay-ess”. One semester is about 30 ECTS credits.
mat-a22-10-ects-punkt.example: A semester has about thirty ECTS credits.

mat-a22-10-einsicht.tr: exam review (viewing your marked paper); insight
mat-a22-10-einsicht.note: die Prüfungseinsicht — a chance to look at your marked exam.
mat-a22-10-einsicht.example: At the exam review David sees his mistakes.

mat-a22-10-antritt.note: Austrian: der erste / zweite Antritt — first / second attempt.
mat-a22-10-antritt.example: That was only his first attempt.

mat-a22-10-sprechstunde.example: The professor has office hours on Wednesday.

mat-a22-10-nachfragen.tr: to ask (for clarification), to follow up
mat-a22-10-nachfragen.note: bei + Dat nachfragen — to check with someone.

mat-a22-10-bewerten.tr: to mark, to grade, to assess
mat-a22-10-bewerten.example: The problem was given zero points.

mat-a22-10-studienplan.example: According to the curriculum, analysis is in the first semester.

mat-a22-10-pflichtfach.note: die Pflicht — duty. Opposite: das Wahlfach.

mat-a22-10-abbrechen.tr: to drop out of, to break off
mat-a22-10-abbrechen.note: das Studium abbrechen — to drop out of university.
mat-a22-10-abbrechen.example: David doesn't want to drop out.

pfl-a11-01-pflegekraft.note: A neutral word for men and women. Also: die Pflegefachfrau / der Pflegefachmann.

pfl-a11-01-arzt.note: A female doctor is die Ärztin. Address: Herr Doktor / Frau Doktor + surname.
pfl-a11-01-arzt.example: The doctor comes at eight o'clock.

pfl-a11-01-patient.note: A female patient is die Patientin. Special declension: den / dem Patienten.
pfl-a11-01-patient.example: The patient's name is Mr Schmidt.

pfl-a11-01-station.note: auf der Station — on the ward (with auf, not in).

pfl-a11-01-zimmer.note: The plural doesn't change: ein Zimmer — zwei Zimmer.
pfl-a11-01-zimmer.example: Mr Schmidt is in room five.

pfl-a11-01-heissen.note: Ich heiße … — my name is …; Wie heißen Sie? — What is your name?

pfl-a11-01-guten-morgen.note: Until about 11 a.m. In the daytime: Guten Tag; in the evening: Guten Abend.

pfl-a11-01-kollege.note: A female colleague is die Kollegin. Special declension: den / dem Kollegen.

pfl-a11-01-neu.note: Ich bin neu hier. — I'm new here.

pfl-a11-01-arbeiten.note: du arbeitest, er arbeitet — with -e- before the ending.

pfl-a11-01-helfen.note: helfen + dative: Ich helfe dem Patienten. du hilfst, er hilft.

pfl-a11-01-namensschild.example: My name is on the name badge.

pfl-a11-01-fruehdienst.note: Shifts: der Frühdienst, der Spätdienst (late), der Nachtdienst (night).
pfl-a11-01-fruehdienst.collocation: to be on the early shift
pfl-a11-01-fruehdienst.example: I'm on the early shift today.

pfl-a11-01-wie-geht-es-ihnen.tr: How are you? How are you feeling?
pfl-a11-01-wie-geht-es-ihnen.note: Formal. Informal: Wie geht es dir? Answer: Danke, gut.
pfl-a11-01-wie-geht-es-ihnen.example: Good afternoon, Mrs Lehmann! How are you feeling?

pfl-a11-02-arm.note: der Arm — the whole arm, die Hand — the hand.

pfl-a11-02-bein.note: das Bein — the whole leg, der Fuß — the foot.

pfl-a11-02-ruecken.note: auf dem Rücken liegen — to lie on your back.

pfl-a11-02-wehtun.note: Separable: Der Kopf tut weh. Wo tut es weh? — Where does it hurt?

pfl-a11-02-ohr.example: I can't hear well in my left ear.

pfl-a11-02-knie.note: The plural doesn't change: zwei Knie.

pfl-a11-02-zeigen.note: zeigen + dative + accusative: Zeigen Sie mir das Knie.

pfl-a11-03-uhr.note: um acht Uhr — at eight o'clock. But: zwei Stunden — two hours (duration).
pfl-a11-03-uhr.example: The ward round is at nine o'clock.

pfl-a11-03-stunde.note: eine halbe Stunde — half an hour.
pfl-a11-03-stunde.example: The break lasts half an hour.

pfl-a11-03-halb.tr: half; (time) half before the next hour

pfl-a11-03-viertel.note: Viertel nach acht = 8:15, Viertel vor neun = 8:45.

pfl-a11-03-frueh.note: Also: am frühen Morgen — early in the morning.

pfl-a11-03-spaet.note: zu spät — too late: Ich bin zu spät. — I'm late.

pfl-a11-03-puenktlich.note: Punctuality at work is very important in Germany.

pfl-a11-03-termin.example: Mr Schmidt has an appointment at ten o'clock.

pfl-a11-03-anrufen.note: anrufen + accusative: Ich rufe den Arzt an. Separable prefix.

pfl-a11-03-grad.note: Read: 38,5 Grad — achtunddreißig Komma fünf Grad. The plural doesn't change.
pfl-a11-03-grad.example: She has a temperature of thirty-eight degrees.

pfl-a11-03-messen.note: du misst, er misst. Fieber messen — to take someone's temperature.

pfl-a11-03-fieber.note: Fieber haben — to have a fever. No plural.

pfl-a11-04-woche.example: This week I'm on the early shift.

pfl-a11-04-montag.note: Days: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag. am Montag — on Monday.

pfl-a11-04-wochenende.example: At the weekend I'm on night shift.

pfl-a11-04-dienstplan.example: The rota hangs in the office.

pfl-a11-04-spaetdienst.note: Usually from about 1:30 p.m. to 10 p.m.
pfl-a11-04-spaetdienst.example: Tomorrow I'm on the late shift.

pfl-a11-04-nachtdienst.example: The night shift starts at nine p.m.

pfl-a11-04-frei.note: Ich habe frei. — I'm off. Ist der Platz frei? — Is this seat free?

pfl-a11-04-schicht.note: die Schicht ≈ der Dienst. in Schichten arbeiten — to do shift work.

pfl-a11-04-morgen.note: morgen (tomorrow) is lowercase; der Morgen (morning) is capitalised. morgen früh — tomorrow morning.

pfl-a11-04-anfangen.note: Separable: Der Dienst fängt um sechs an. du fängst an.

pfl-a11-04-feierabend.tr: end of the working day; time off after work
pfl-a11-04-feierabend.note: Schönen Feierabend! — Have a nice evening! (after work)
pfl-a11-04-feierabend.example: I finish work at two p.m.

pfl-a11-04-muede.example: After the night shift I'm tired.

pfl-a11-04-tauschen.note: den Dienst tauschen — to swap shifts.

pfl-a11-05-krank.note: krank sein — to be ill. Ich bin krank. — I'm ill.

pfl-a11-05-schmerz.note: Usually plural: Schmerzen haben — to be in pain.

pfl-a11-05-schlecht.note: Mir geht es schlecht. — I feel bad.

pfl-a11-05-schlafen.note: du schläfst, er schläft. Gut geschlafen? — Did you sleep well?

pfl-a11-05-angst.note: Angst haben vor + dative — to be afraid of something.

pfl-a11-05-kalt.note: Mir ist kalt. — I'm cold (not “Ich bin kalt”!).

pfl-a11-05-warm.note: Mir ist warm. — I'm warm / hot.

pfl-a11-05-schwindlig.note: Mir ist schwindlig. — I feel dizzy.

pfl-a11-05-uebel.note: Mir ist übel. — I feel sick.

pfl-a11-05-klingel.note: klingeln — to ring, to press the call button.
pfl-a11-05-klingel.example: The call button is here by the bed.

pfl-a11-06-abendessen.note: In Germany dinner is often cold: bread, cheese, cold meat (Abendbrot).

pfl-a11-06-essen.note: du isst, er isst. das Essen — food, meal.

pfl-a11-06-trinken.note: Older patients often drink too little — remind them.

pfl-a11-06-wasser.note: Wasser mit / ohne Kohlensäure — sparkling / still water.
pfl-a11-06-wasser.example: Would you like a glass of water?

pfl-a11-06-hunger.note: Hunger haben — to be hungry. Ich habe Hunger. — I'm hungry.

pfl-a11-06-brot.example: There's bread and cheese for breakfast.

pfl-a11-06-tasse.example: Would you like a cup of tea?

pfl-a11-06-tablett.note: Don't confuse with die Tablette — tablet, pill!
pfl-a11-06-tablett.example: I put the tray on the table.

pfl-a11-06-schmecken.note: Schmeckt es Ihnen? — Do you like it? Es schmeckt gut. — It tastes good.

pfl-a11-07-maske.example: In the room we wear a mask.

pfl-a11-07-spritze.note: eine Spritze bekommen — to get an injection.

pfl-a11-07-tablette.note: Don't confuse with das Tablett — tray!

pfl-a11-07-waage.example: The scales are in the bathroom.

pfl-a11-07-wagen.example: The trolley is in the corridor.

pfl-a11-07-schere.note: Singular in German: eine Schere — a pair of scissors.

pfl-a11-07-becher.example: The tablets are in the cup.

pfl-a11-07-rollstuhl.example: Mrs Wolf is sitting in the wheelchair.

pfl-a11-07-holen.note: holen — to go and get. Ich hole den Rollstuhl.
pfl-a11-07-holen.example: Can you get some gloves, please?

pfl-a11-07-bringen.note: bringen + dative + accusative: Ich bringe Ihnen Wasser.

pfl-a11-08-waschen.note: sich waschen — to wash (yourself). du wäschst, er wäscht.

pfl-a11-08-duschen.example: Would you like to take a shower today?

pfl-a11-08-bad.example: The bathroom is next to the room.

pfl-a11-08-toilette.note: auf die Toilette gehen — to go to the toilet. Colloquial: das Klo.
pfl-a11-08-toilette.example: I need to go to the toilet.

pfl-a11-08-kamm.example: The comb is in the wardrobe.

pfl-a11-08-kleidung.note: No plural. One item — das Kleidungsstück.
pfl-a11-08-kleidung.example: The clothes are in the wardrobe.

pfl-a11-08-hose.note: Singular in German: eine Hose — a pair of trousers.

pfl-a11-08-socke.example: Your feet are cold. Here are some socks.

pfl-a11-08-nachthemd.example: Mrs Wolf needs a fresh nightgown.

pfl-a11-08-anziehen.note: sich anziehen — to get dressed. Separable: Ich ziehe mich an.

pfl-a11-09-mutter.example: My mother is eighty years old.

pfl-a11-09-mann.example: My husband is coming this evening.

pfl-a11-09-frau.note: meine Frau — my wife; Frau Wolf — Mrs Wolf.
pfl-a11-09-frau.example: Mr Schmidt is waiting for his wife.

pfl-a11-09-besuch.note: Sie haben Besuch! — You have a visitor!
pfl-a11-09-besuch.example: Mr Schmidt, you have a visitor!

pfl-a11-09-besuchszeit.example: Visiting hours are from two to seven p.m.

pfl-a11-09-geschenk.example: This is a present for you.

pfl-a11-09-angehoerige.note: Declined like an adjective: der Angehörige, ein Angehöriger; a woman — die Angehörige. Mostly plural: die Angehörigen.

pfl-a11-09-warten.note: warten auf + accusative: Ich warte auf den Arzt.

pfl-a11-09-froh.example: Mrs Wolf is happy about the visit.

pfl-a11-10-tisch.example: The glass is on the table.

pfl-a11-10-stuhl.example: Please sit down on the chair.

pfl-a11-10-licht.example: Shall I switch off the light?

pfl-a11-10-schrank.example: Your bag is in the wardrobe.

pfl-a11-10-brille.note: Singular in German: eine Brille — a pair of glasses.

pfl-a11-10-tasche.example: The bag is under the bed.

pfl-a11-10-laut.example: The man in room three is very loud.

pfl-a11-10-stoeren.note: Entschuldigung, darf ich kurz stören? — Sorry, may I bother you for a moment?

pfl-a12-01-stark.note: starke Schmerzen — severe pain. Opposite: leicht (mild).

pfl-a12-01-skala.note: Schmerzskala von 0 bis 10 — pain scale from 0 to 10.
pfl-a12-01-skala.example: On a scale from zero to ten: how bad is the pain?

pfl-a12-01-seit.note: seit + dative: seit gestern — since yesterday, seit zwei Tagen — for two days.
pfl-a12-01-seit.example: How long have you had the pain?

pfl-a12-01-stechen.tr: to sting, to stab; (pain) to be sharp
pfl-a12-01-stechen.note: Es sticht hier. — There's a sharp pain here. stechende Schmerzen — stabbing pain.
pfl-a12-01-stechen.example: There's a stabbing pain in my chest.

pfl-a12-01-kopfschmerzen.example: I've had a headache since this morning.

pfl-a12-01-bauchschmerzen.example: After eating he has a stomach ache.

pfl-a12-01-druecken.note: Tut es weh, wenn ich hier drücke? — Does it hurt when I press here?
pfl-a12-01-druecken.example: Does it hurt when I press here?

pfl-a12-01-aushalten.note: Ich halte das nicht aus! — I can't stand it!
pfl-a12-01-aushalten.example: I can't bear the pain any more.

pfl-a12-01-schmerzmittel.example: The doctor will give you a painkiller.

pfl-a12-01-waermflasche.example: A hot-water bottle helps with stomach ache.

pfl-a12-01-bewegen.note: Bewegen Sie bitte die Finger. — Please move your fingers.

pfl-a12-02-aufstehen.tr: to get up, to stand up
pfl-a12-02-aufstehen.note: Separable; perfect with sein: Ich bin aufgestanden.

pfl-a12-02-setzen.tr: to seat; (sich setzen) to sit down
pfl-a12-02-setzen.note: Setzen Sie sich bitte. — Please sit down.
pfl-a12-02-setzen.example: Please sit on the edge of the bed.

pfl-a12-02-bettkante.collocation: to sit on the edge of the bed
pfl-a12-02-bettkante.example: She is sitting on the edge of the bed.

pfl-a12-02-langsam.note: Ganz langsam! — Very slowly! Opposite: schnell.

pfl-a12-02-vorsichtig.example: Be careful, the floor is wet.

pfl-a12-02-stuetzen.note: sich stützen auf + accusative — to lean on something.
pfl-a12-02-stuetzen.example: I'll support you by the arm.

pfl-a12-02-fallen.note: Perfect with sein. hinfallen — to fall down.

pfl-a12-02-flur.example: We'll walk a little in the corridor.

pfl-a12-02-laufen.note: In everyday speech laufen often means gehen (to walk).
pfl-a12-02-laufen.example: Mr Schmidt already walks on his own.

pfl-a12-02-schritt.note: Schritt für Schritt — step by step.
pfl-a12-02-schritt.example: Five more steps to the door!

pfl-a12-02-festhalten.tr: to hold; (sich festhalten) to hold on
pfl-a12-02-festhalten.note: sich festhalten an + dative: Halten Sie sich am Geländer fest.

pfl-a12-02-allein.note: Bitte nicht allein aufstehen! — Please don't get up on your own!
pfl-a12-02-allein.example: Please don't get up on your own.

pfl-a12-03-creme.example: The cream is good for the skin.

pfl-a12-03-eincremen.note: Separable: Ich creme Ihren Rücken ein.
pfl-a12-03-eincremen.example: I'll put cream on your legs.

pfl-a12-03-rasieren.example: Would you like to shave today?

pfl-a12-03-rasierer.example: The shaver is in the bathroom.

pfl-a12-03-haar.note: Usually plural: die Haare waschen — to wash your hair.

pfl-a12-03-schuessel.example: I fill the basin with warm water.

pfl-a12-03-wechseln.example: We're changing the bed linen now.

pfl-a12-03-zahnprothese.note: Colloquial: die dritten Zähne, das Gebiss.
pfl-a12-03-zahnprothese.example: The denture is in the cup.

pfl-a12-03-umdrehen.tr: to turn; (sich umdrehen) to turn over
pfl-a12-03-umdrehen.note: Drehen Sie sich bitte auf die Seite. — Please turn on your side.

pfl-a12-04-loeffel.example: Here's a spoon for the soup.

pfl-a12-04-schneiden.note: klein schneiden — to cut into small pieces.
pfl-a12-04-schneiden.collocation: to cut the meat into small pieces
pfl-a12-04-schneiden.example: Shall I cut the meat into small pieces?

pfl-a12-04-serviette.example: I'll put a napkin down for you.

pfl-a12-04-allergie.note: eine Allergie gegen + accusative: gegen Nüsse.

pfl-a12-04-diabetes.note: Diabetiker / Diabetikerin — diabetic. Colloquial: Zucker haben.

pfl-a12-04-zucker.example: No sugar in the tea, please.

pfl-a12-04-saft.example: Would you like apple juice or orange juice?

pfl-a12-04-milch.example: Do you take your coffee with milk?

pfl-a12-04-portion.example: I'd like just a small portion.

pfl-a12-04-bestellen.note: In hospitals patients often order tomorrow's meals from a menu.
pfl-a12-04-bestellen.example: What would you like to order for tomorrow?

pfl-a12-05-blutdruck.example: I'm going to take your blood pressure now.

pfl-a12-05-manschette.example: I'll put the cuff around your arm.

pfl-a12-05-hoch.note: Before a noun: ein hoher Blutdruck (no -c-).
pfl-a12-05-hoch.example: The blood pressure is too high.

pfl-a12-05-wert.note: Die Werte sind gut. — The readings are good.

pfl-a12-05-notieren.example: I record the value in the chart.

pfl-a12-05-blutzucker.example: We check the blood sugar before meals.

pfl-a12-05-atmen.note: tief einatmen — breathe in deeply, ausatmen — breathe out.

pfl-a12-05-gewicht.example: The weight hasn't changed since yesterday.

pfl-a12-05-kurve.note: In German hospitals “die Kurve” is the sheet with a patient's readings.
pfl-a12-05-kurve.example: All the values are in the chart.

pfl-a12-05-regelmaessig.example: We take the blood pressure regularly.

pfl-a12-06-einnehmen.note: Separable: Nehmen Sie die Tablette nach dem Essen ein.

pfl-a12-06-tropfen.note: zehn Tropfen in Wasser — ten drops in water.
pfl-a12-06-tropfen.example: You'll get ten drops in a glass of water.

pfl-a12-06-salbe.example: The ointment goes on the wound.

pfl-a12-06-morgens.note: morgens, mittags, abends, nachts — in the morning, at midday, in the evening, at night.
pfl-a12-06-morgens.example: You take this tablet in the morning.

pfl-a12-06-abends.example: In the evening she gets a sleeping pill.

pfl-a12-06-nuechtern.note: nüchtern bleiben — not to eat anything (before a test or surgery).
pfl-a12-06-nuechtern.example: Please don't eat anything tomorrow morning.

pfl-a12-06-rezept.example: You need a prescription for this medicine.

pfl-a12-06-apotheke.example: The hospital pharmacy is in the basement.

pfl-a12-06-wirken.example: The painkiller works after twenty minutes.

pfl-a12-06-beipackzettel.example: The side effects are listed in the package leaflet.

pfl-a12-06-infusion.example: Mr Yilmaz is getting an infusion.

pfl-a12-06-verschreiben.example: The doctor prescribes a new medicine.

pfl-a12-07-stuerzen.note: der Sturz — fall. More formal than fallen.
pfl-a12-07-stuerzen.example: Mr Becker fell in the bathroom.

pfl-a12-07-notarzt.example: Call the emergency doctor at once!

pfl-a12-07-rettungswagen.note: The emergency number in Germany is 112.
pfl-a12-07-rettungswagen.example: The ambulance will be here in five minutes.

pfl-a12-08-aufnahme.example: The admission takes half an hour.

pfl-a12-08-name.note: der Vorname — first name, der Nachname — surname. Special declension: den Namen.

pfl-a12-08-versichertenkarte.example: Do you have your health insurance card with you?

pfl-a12-08-krankenkasse.example: Which health insurance fund are you with?

pfl-a12-08-ausfuellen.example: I'll fill in the form with you.

pfl-a12-08-unterschrift.example: Your signature is still missing here.

pfl-a12-08-wertsachen.example: Please don't leave valuables in the room.

pfl-a12-08-grund.note: aus diesem Grund — for this reason.
pfl-a12-08-grund.example: What's the reason for your visit?

pfl-a12-08-groesse.example: Your height is one metre seventy.

pfl-a12-09-urin.note: Colloquial: Wasser lassen (to pass water). der Urinbeutel — urine bag.

pfl-a12-09-stuhlgang.note: Polite question: Hatten Sie heute schon Stuhlgang?
pfl-a12-09-stuhlgang.example: Have you had a bowel movement today?

pfl-a12-09-toilettenstuhl.example: I'll bring the commode to your bed.

pfl-a12-09-urinflasche.example: The urinal hangs on the bed.

pfl-a12-09-peinlich.note: Das muss Ihnen nicht peinlich sein. — There's no need to be embarrassed.
pfl-a12-09-peinlich.example: There's no need to be embarrassed.

pfl-a12-09-durchfall.example: She has had diarrhoea since yesterday.

pfl-a12-09-verstopfung.example: Drinking lots of water helps with constipation.

pfl-a12-09-muessen.tr: must, to have to; (colloquial) to need the toilet
pfl-a12-09-muessen.note: Ich muss mal. — I need the toilet (colloquial).
pfl-a12-09-muessen.example: I need to go to the toilet.

pfl-a12-10-uebergabe.note: Bei der Übergabe — during the handover.
pfl-a12-10-uebergabe.example: The handover is at two p.m.

pfl-a12-10-unruhig.example: Mrs Wolf was restless in the night.

pfl-a12-10-besonderheit.note: Keine Besonderheiten. — Nothing unusual (a typical report phrase).

cyber-a12-sicher:0.text:
Anna is twenty and studies in Vienna. Today she is making a new account for the university. First she needs a username. She takes “anna.wien”. Then she needs a password. Her first password is “anna123”. That is not secure, says her brother Max. It is too short and too simple.

Anna makes a new password with fourteen characters. Now it is secure. In the evening Anna sits in a café. The Wi-Fi in the café is free but not secure. Anna does not sign in at the café. She waits and signs in at home. At the end she always signs out.

gloss.meldet: signs in (sich anmelden) / signs out (sich abmelden) — look at the prefix at the end

questions: Where does Anna study?
Why is “anna123” not secure?
Where does Anna sign in?

wrong: My password is not secure now.

translate.tr: The Wi-Fi in the café is not secure.
wrong: The Wi-Fi in the café is free.
The Wi-Fi at home is not secure.
The Wi-Fi in the café is secure.

translate.tr: At the end she signs out.
wrong: At the end she signs in.

cyber-a12-sicher:1.text:
On Monday Max gets a strange message. It says: “Your account is blocked. Click here and write your password!” Max is not sure. He asks his sister Anna.

Anna says: “That's a hacker. A password is secret. You never write it in a message.” Max does not click. But he has forgotten his password. He changes it and gets a code by text message. He types the code and everything is fine.

In the evening Anna finds a virus on her computer. A good program protects the computer. Anna says: “We have to be more careful!”

gloss.aufpassen: to be careful, to pay attention

questions: What does the message say?
What does Max do with the password?
What does Anna find in the evening?

translate.tr: A good program protects the computer.
wrong: A good program deletes the computer.
A good computer protects the program.

cyber-a12-02-profil:0.text:
Sophie is fifteen and goes to school in Vienna. She has a new profile in an app. Her profile picture shows her cat. Every day she posts a photo or a video.

Her brother Emil sees the profile and asks: “Is your profile public?” Sophie says: “Yes, why?” Emil explains: “A public post is visible to everyone. Strangers see your photos too.”

Sophie makes the profile private. Now her posts are only visible to friends. In the evening she shares a video from her school. But she only shares it with her class.
questions: What does Sophie's profile picture show?
Who sees a public post?
Who does Sophie share the video with?

translate.tr: The post is visible to everyone.
wrong: The post is only visible to friends.
The photo is visible to everyone.
The post is visible to nobody.

translate.tr: She shares a video with her class.
wrong: He shares a video with his class.
She shares a photo with her class.

cyber-a12-02-profil:1.text:
On Saturday Sophie gets a friend request. The name is Leon. Sophie doesn't know him. He is a stranger. Sophie declines the request.

Then she reads a comment under her photo: “How embarrassing!” The comment is mean. Sophie is sad. She deletes the comment.

After that Sophie opens the settings. Now only friends can write comments. Her friend Mia sends a request too. Sophie knows Mia from school. She is happy to accept the request.
questions: Who sends the first request?
What does Sophie do with the comment?
How does Sophie know Mia?
Who can write comments now?

cyber-a12-03-links:0.text:
Paul goes to school in Vienna. On Tuesday he gets an email. The subject is: “Urgent! You have won!” The sender is an unknown address. Paul doesn't know the sender.

The email says: “Your prize is a new phone. Click on the link quickly!” Paul is happy. He wants to click on the link right away.

But his grandma calls out: “Stop! Is the email real? You didn't take part in any game. So you can't win anything either.” Paul doesn't click on the link. He shows the email to his teacher.
questions: What does the subject say?
Does Paul know the sender?
What does Paul do at the end?

cyber-a12-03-links:1.text:
On Wednesday Ms Berger talks to the class about spam. She says: “Spam is often a trick. A free voucher? A parcel waiting for you? That's usually fake.”

Then she shows a fake website. It looks like the page of a bank. But the address has a mistake: “banck” and not “bank”. There are also a lot of mistakes in the text.

Ms Berger says: “Ignore emails like that! Delete them from your inbox. Never write your password on a website like that.” Paul laughs. Now he knows the trick.
questions: What does Ms Berger talk about?
What is wrong with the website?
What should the pupils do with spam?

translate.tr: My inbox is full of spam.
wrong: Your inbox is full of spam.

translate.tr: The voucher is just a trick.
wrong: The voucher is a real gift.
The prize is just a trick.

cyber-a12-04-handy-sperren:0.text:
Lukas has a new phone. His sister Nina helps him. First he makes a PIN. Nina says: “Don't take your birthday. Everyone knows it.”

Then Lukas saves his fingerprint. He puts his finger on the sensor. Now he unlocks the phone really quickly. The phone also knows his face.

Nina shows him a pattern too. “A pattern is okay, but people can easily see it,” she says. At the end Lukas locks the phone. On the lock screen you now see only the time and a photo of his dog.
questions: What shouldn't Lukas take as his PIN?
How does Lukas unlock the phone quickly?
What can you see on the lock screen?

wrong: The phone doesn't know his face.

translate.tr: A pattern is not very secure.
wrong: A PIN is not very secure.
A pattern is not very convenient.

cyber-a12-04-handy-sperren:1.text:
On Friday Lukas takes the tram to school. There he notices: the phone is gone! He has lost it. Lukas is nervous. But the phone is locked.

A man finds the phone and is curious. He enters a wrong PIN three times. After three attempts the phone is locked for an hour. The man takes it to the lost and found.

In the afternoon Lukas picks up his phone at the lost and found. His friend Lena asks: “Can you lend me your phone?” Lukas says: “Yes, but I'll unlock it with my thumb. My PIN has six digits and stays secret.”
questions: What does the man do with the phone?
Why can't the man open the phone?
When does Lukas pick up the phone?
How does Lukas unlock the phone for Lena?

translate.tr: Can you lend me your phone?
wrong: Can you lend me your laptop?

translate.tr: The phone is at the lost and found.
wrong: The phone is not at the lost and found.
The key is at the lost and found.

cyber-a12-05-updates:0.text:
Mira goes to school in Vienna. In the morning she sees a message on her computer: “An update is available.” Mira has no time. She clicks on “Later”.

In the evening she asks her brother Felix. Felix says: “The version on your computer is old. It has a bug. A hacker can use the bug. The new version is up to date and secure.”

Mira downloads the update and installs it. Then she has to restart the computer. Felix says: “Make updates automatic! Then you don't have to think about it.”
questions: What does Mira do in the morning?
Why is the old version not secure?
What does Felix say at the end?

translate.tr: I have to restart the computer.
wrong: I have to switch off the computer.
You have to restart the computer.

translate.tr: The old version has a bug.
wrong: The new version has a bug.
The old version has no bug.

cyber-a12-05-updates:1.text:
Felix has an old laptop. Today a big update for the operating system comes. The update is important, but it takes a long time.

First the battery is almost flat. Felix gets the cable. Then he waits. An hour later the update still isn't finished. Felix isn't happy. He wants to play a game.

Finally everything is done. Felix opens the settings. There he finds “Automatic updates”. He clicks on “On”. Now the updates come at night. Felix doesn't have to wait any more, and his laptop stays secure.

gloss.ein: a, one; (here, on a switch) on
gloss.am: at, on (am Anfang — at the beginning)
gloss.später: later (eine Stunde später — an hour later)

questions: What is almost flat at the beginning?
What does Felix want to do?
Where does Felix find “Automatic updates”?
When do the updates come now?

cyber-a12-06-unterwegs:0.text:
Sara is at the station in Vienna. She is taking the train to Salzburg. On the way she wants to listen to music and write messages.

At the station there is a free hotspot. Sara connects her phone to the network. Her friend Emil says: “The Wi-Fi at the station is public. Anyone can use it. Don't enter a password there!”

On the train the Wi-Fi is slow. Then comes a tunnel, and Sara has no reception. She reads a book. After the tunnel the network is back.

gloss.ein: a, one; (here) part of eingeben — to enter

questions: Where is Sara going?
What does Emil say about the Wi-Fi at the station?
Why does Sara have no reception?

translate.tr: On the train I have no reception.
wrong: On the train I have good reception.
At the station I have no reception.

translate.tr: Sara connects her phone to the hotspot.
wrong: Sara disconnects her phone from the hotspot.
Sara connects her laptop to the hotspot.

translate.tr: The Wi-Fi at the station is free.
wrong: The Wi-Fi on the train is free.
The Wi-Fi at the station costs money.

cyber-a12-06-unterwegs:1.text:
Emil is going on a trip to Berlin. He is flying. Before take-off he turns on airplane mode. Then he listens to music with his headphones. The headphones need Bluetooth.

At the hotel Emil's battery is flat. He looks for his charger, but it's at home. A stranger says: “I have a cable for you.” Emil says: “Thanks, but no.” A stranger's cable can be dangerous.

In the evening Emil turns off Bluetooth. Sara said: “When you're out and about, Bluetooth is always off!”

gloss.schaltet: switches on / off (look at the prefix ein/aus at the end)
gloss.ein: a, one; (here) part of einschalten — to switch on
gloss.aus: off; (here) part of ausschalten — to switch off

questions: How does Emil travel to Berlin?
What did Emil forget?
Why doesn't Emil take the cable?
What does Emil do in the evening?

wrong: Don't connect to your own devices.

cyber-a12-07-daten:0.text:
Paula is thirteen and lives in Vienna. She wants to join a chess club online. For that she has to fill in a form.

First she writes her first name and her surname. Then the form asks for: address, phone number, birthday. At the end the club also wants a photo.

Paula asks her mother. Her mother says: “First name and birthday are okay. But why does a chess club need your address and a photo?” Paula doesn't write a phone number and doesn't upload a photo. She only fills in the most important things.

gloss.mitmachen: to join in, to take part
gloss.hoch: up; (here) part of hochladen — to upload
gloss.ins: into the (ins Formular — in the form)

questions: What does Paula want to join?
What does the club want at the end?
What doesn't Paula write in the form?
Who helps Paula?

cyber-a12-07-daten:1.text:
Paula's friend Leon finds a prize draw on the internet. You can win a new phone! Leon only has to write his data: name, street, phone number and a photo of his ID.

Leon is happy, but Paula says: “Stop! That's personal. The company is unknown. Maybe it passes on your data.”

Leon thinks about it. He doesn't give away his data. A week later he reads in the news: the prize draw was a scam. The company collected and sold a lot of data.

gloss.später: later (eine Woche später — a week later)

questions: What can you win in the prize draw?
What does Paula say about the company?
What was the prize draw?

translate.tr: The company passes on your data.
wrong: The company passed on your data.

translate.tr: Leon doesn't give away his address.

cyber-a12-08-online-einkaufen:0.text:
Jonas is sixteen and lives in Vienna. He needs new headphones for school. In the shop they are too expensive. So he looks for an online shop.

He finds nice headphones. The price is good: twenty-nine euros. Jonas puts the headphones in the cart. Then he has to pay. But he doesn't have a credit card. His mother helps him and pays with her credit card.

The shop writes: “Thank you! We'll deliver in three days.” Jonas waits. On Friday the parcel comes. The headphones are great. Jonas often orders online now, but always with his mother.

gloss.tagen: days; (in drei Tagen) in three days

questions: Why does Jonas buy the headphones online?
Who pays with the credit card?
When does the parcel come?

translate.tr: He puts the headphones in the cart.
wrong: He takes the headphones out of the cart.
She puts the headphones in the cart.
He puts the headphones in the bag.

translate.tr: His mother pays with her credit card.
wrong: His father pays with his credit card.
His mother orders a credit card.

cyber-a12-08-online-einkaufen:1.text:
Mira wants to buy a jacket. On the internet she sees a great offer: the jacket costs only ten euros! Normally it costs a hundred euros. That's very cheap.

Mira reads the reviews. There aren't any. The shop also has no address and no legal notice. Her brother David says: “That's a fake shop. It's a scam!”

But Mira has already paid. She gets an invoice by email, but no parcel. Mira calls her bank. The bank helps her. After two weeks Mira gets her money back. Now she always reads the reviews first.

gloss.impressum: legal notice (who runs the site, address)

questions: How much does the jacket cost in the offer?
What doesn't the shop have?
Who helps Mira at the end?

wrong: She doesn't get her money back.

cyber-a12-09-hilfe-holen:0.text:
Elif is fourteen. For a week she has had a problem. In her class chat a boy insults her every day. He writes nasty messages about her. That's bullying. Elif is afraid and sleeps badly.
